warden.actions.summary: Carries out every mutating cleanup and undo operation (quarantine volumes, recycle or delete snapshots, stop or start instances, quarantine or release Elastic IPs, restores). Plan-gated actions run freeze check, Watchdog sign-off, plan validation, a live re-describe and fingerprint recheck before each mutation. Every call returns a persisted receipt and writes audit lines; per-item failures never raise.

warden.scanner.summary: Read-only waste scanner for one AWS region. It lists unattached EBS volumes, owned snapshots, running instances and Elastic IPs, gathers evidence (AMIs, launch templates, CloudWatch, Route 53, load balancers, CloudTrail, dry runs) and gives each a keep, review or act verdict. It saves the findings as a Plan for later approval and writes a scan audit entry, but never changes AWS.

warden.console.summary: Serves the read-only Warden Console as GET-only custom routes on Warden's own MCP server: one self-contained HTML page with a strict CSP, a JSON state snapshot (status, last scan, refusals, receipts, rollback window, ledger tail), and a listing of demo resources in the moto simulator. Every route checks the Host header against DNS rebinding, and every section degrades to an {"error": ...} value instead of a traceback. The embedded page renders all data with textContent/createElement only and never calls a mutating tool; approvals stay in the TrueForge chat.

warden.ui.summary: Builds deterministic OpenUI program strings (generative UI dashboards) that Warden's tools return for TrueForge's chat, so the model pastes the UI rather than retyping numbers, ids and refusals. It covers scan reports, Watchdog sign-offs, action receipts and the rollback window, and routes every string through _q() so untrusted tag text cannot escape an OpenUI string literal.

warden.server.summary: Defines the Warden MCP server and its 19 tools: read-only status, scan, plan, receipt, backup, rollback and ledger queries, the watchdog_verify sign-off, six plan-gated executors and four undo tools, each a thin wrapper over the scanner, watchdog, actions and audit modules. It holds the shared Settings/AwsClients, turns every exception into a JSON error with a remediation hint, and attaches OpenUI dashboards to results. It also registers the read-only console HTTP routes and runs the server over streamable HTTP at /mcp.

warden.watchdog.summary: Independent verifier that re-describes each planned resource with its own boto3 calls and re-checks scope, protection tags, the plan fingerprint and action-specific safety (AMI and launch-template use, load balancer targets, DNS records, quarantine window) before issuing a single-use HMAC sign-off token bound to plan, action, approved ids and fingerprints. It validates and consumes those tokens for the executor and builds the live rollback window of changes that can still be undone. Every sign-off, block, rejection and consumption is written to the hash-chained ledger.

warden.audit.summary: Keeps Warden's append-only audit ledger in state_dir/audit.jsonl, where each line is hash-chained to the previous one and anchored by a ledger.head file so edits, truncation or deletion are detected. It also creates ids, writes JSON atomically, stores action receipts, answers per-resource history, and checks Elastic IP quarantine evidence before a release.

warden.aws.summary: Builds cached boto3 clients for one region, pointing them at real AWS or, in mock mode, at the moto endpoint with dummy credentials and mock shims. It also provides helpers to read AWS error codes, run waiters that tolerate eventual consistency, and probe permissions with DryRun calls.

warden.config.summary: Defines the immutable Settings dataclass and the warden: tag names shared across the codebase, and builds Settings from environment variables (plus a .env file) with validation. It also provides is_frozen, the kill switch checked on every call.

warden.mock.summary: Lets Warden run against a local moto server by adding botocore event hooks for what moto lacks: a simulated Recycle Bin stored in state_dir/mock/recycle_bin.json, older instance launch times, and empty CloudTrail lookups. It also seeds synthetic idle CloudWatch metrics for demo instances.

warden.plan.summary: Implements the plan lock: a scan records certified resource ids, verdicts, intended actions and state fingerprints in a time-limited plan file, and every mutating request is checked against that plan. It rejects unknown actions, expired or foreign plans, wildcards, oversized batches and ids the plan did not mark for that action.

warden.policy.summary: Pure tag-based safety rules with no AWS calls: it decides whether a resource is protected (production, legal hold, DR, warden:protect), owned by IaC or autoscaling, or carries instruction-like text, and whether it is inside the configured scope tag. It also sanitises tags and drops reserved aws: tags before copying.

warden.pricing.summary: Holds static on-demand list prices for us-east-1 and ap-south-1 and turns them into monthly USD estimates for EBS volumes, snapshots, Elastic IPs and EC2 instances. Unknown regions fall back to us-east-1 rates; the figures are estimates, not a bill.

agent.setup_agent.summary: Registers the Warden MCP server and the Warden agent (plus an optional read-only warden-reporter agent) in TrueForge through the trueforge_sdk. It builds the manifests as pure data, then creates or updates them idempotently, and can print the payloads with --dry-run instead of calling TrueForge.

scripts._common.summary: Shared read-only helpers for the demo scripts (preflight, plant, reset). It resolves the default subnet and Amazon Linux 2023 AMI, builds and checks warden:demo=true tags, finds the Recycle Bin rule Warden relies on, and turns AWS/config failures into one-line errors with exit code 2.

scripts.mock_server.summary: Starts a local in-memory moto server for Warden's mock mode, used when no AWS account is available. It clears Warden's simulated Recycle Bin state at start-up and runs until Ctrl+C; plant.py, the MCP server and reset.py then point at it via WARDEN_MOCK_ENDPOINT.

scripts.plant.summary: Plants the demo resources Warden is meant to find or refuse, all tagged warden:demo=true, in one AZ of the default VPC. It is idempotent (skips items whose Name tag already exists), adapts to moto in mock mode, and prints the estimated monthly waste Warden should clean up versus the total planted cost.

scripts.preflight.summary: Runs read-only checks that the AWS account and region can host the demo: identity, AZs, default subnet, AMI, DryRun EC2 calls, Recycle Bin rule, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, SSM and IAM reads. It prints a status table and what each non-OK check disables, and never mutates anything.

scripts.reset.summary: Finds every resource tagged warden:demo=true and deletes it in a safe order, and nothing else. By default it only prints what it would delete; --yes performs the deletions and --include-recycle-rule also removes the demo Recycle Bin rule.

warden.actions:_utc_iso.what: Converts a datetime to UTC and formats it as an ISO string ending in 'Z' (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

warden.actions:_result.what: Builds the standard per-resource result dict with resource_id, status, detail, undo hint, backup_snapshot_id and public_ip.
warden.actions:_result.detail: Every action outcome and receipt entry uses this shape.

warden.actions:_skipped.what: Returns a 'skipped' result for a resource paired with zero estimated monthly savings.

warden.actions:_failed.what: Returns a 'failed' result for a resource paired with zero estimated monthly savings.

warden.actions:_parse_utc.what: Parses a Warden ISO timestamp (with trailing 'Z') into a timezone-aware UTC datetime, returning None when missing or malformed.
warden.actions:_parse_utc.detail: Naive datetimes are assumed to be UTC.

warden.actions:_requested.what: Normalises the requested ids (list, tuple or single value) into a deduplicated list of stripped strings, or ['*'] when nothing usable was given.
warden.actions:_requested.detail: Used to label skip results when a whole call is rejected.

warden.actions:_is_not_found.what: Returns True when an AWS error code ends in 'NotFound' or '.Malformed', meaning the resource is treated as gone.

warden.actions:_account.what: Returns the AWS account id from the clients, or 'unknown' if the lookup fails.
warden.actions:_account.detail: Swallows any STS error so the tool never crashes on identity lookup.

warden.actions:_to_aws_tags.what: Converts a tag dict into the AWS list format of {'Key', 'Value'} entries.

warden.actions:_carried_tags.what: Filters a resource's tags down to those Warden may copy onto a backup or restored volume.
warden.actions:_carried_tags.detail: Drops aws:* tags, Warden bookkeeping tags (BOOKKEEPING_TAGS) and the human-owned warden:protect tag in any letter case, which IAM denies Warden writing.

warden.actions:_frozen.what: Returns a skip outcome with FROZEN_DETAIL if the freeze switch is on right now, otherwise None.
warden.actions:_frozen.detail: Freeze is WARDEN_FREEZE=true or a FREEZE file in the state directory; called right before each mutation.

warden.actions:_mark_human_undo.what: Tags a resource a human just brought back with TAG_HUMAN_UNDO_AT=now so later scans do not propose it again; returns '' or a warning string.
warden.actions:_mark_human_undo.detail: Calls ec2 CreateTags, retrying on NotFound (EC2 may lag); never raises because the undo already happened.

warden.actions:_settle.what: Calls a check function up to a few times with a delay between tries and returns True as soon as it passes.
warden.actions:_settle.detail: Compensates for EC2 eventual consistency; defaults to SETTLE_ATTEMPTS=3 with 2-second delays via the patchable _sleep.

warden.actions:_warden_results.what: Scans Warden's saved receipts for a given action and returns (receipt, result) pairs whose result matches the resource id.
warden.actions:_warden_results.detail: Reads via audit.list_receipts and audit.load_receipt; used to prove Warden itself performed an earlier action before undoing it.

warden.actions:_new_receipt.what: Creates an empty receipt dict for an action with a new rcpt id, plan id, account, region, start time, freeze flag and zeroed counts.

warden.actions:_save.what: Persists a receipt via audit.save_receipt, recording a save_error on the receipt instead of raising on OSError.

warden.actions:_finish.what: Fills a receipt's results, status counts, savings total, freeze flag and finish time, saves it, then writes action_item and action audit lines.
warden.actions:_finish.detail: Receipt is saved before the ledger; an audit write OSError is recorded as ledger_error and re-saved, so a performed mutation always returns its receipt.

warden.actions:_safe.what: Runs one per-item action step and converts any unexpected exception into a 'failed' outcome with the AWS error code.
warden.actions:_safe.detail: Guarantees per-item failures never raise out of an action.

warden.actions:_describe_volume.what: Fetches one EBS volume by id and returns its description, or None if it no longer exists.
warden.actions:_describe_volume.detail: Calls DescribeVolumes; NotFound/Malformed errors map to None, other ClientErrors are re-raised.

warden.actions:_describe_snapshot.what: Fetches one EBS snapshot by id and returns its description, or None if it no longer exists.
warden.actions:_describe_snapshot.detail: Calls DescribeSnapshots; NotFound/Malformed errors map to None, other ClientErrors are re-raised.

warden.actions:_describe_instance.what: Fetches one EC2 instance by id and returns its description, or None if it is missing or terminated.
warden.actions:_describe_instance.detail: Calls DescribeInstances and searches reservations for the matching InstanceId; terminated counts as gone.

warden.actions:_describe_address.what: Fetches one Elastic IP by allocation id and returns its description, or None if it no longer exists.
warden.actions:_describe_address.detail: Calls DescribeAddresses; NotFound/Malformed errors map to None, other ClientErrors are re-raised.

warden.actions:_recheck.what: Re-describes an approved plan item and re-runs scope, keep-tag policy and fingerprint checks, returning the live resource or a skip outcome.
warden.actions:_recheck.detail: Skips if the resource is gone, out of scope, has keep reasons, or its plan.fingerprint differs from the approved plan.

warden.actions:_check_signoff.what: Asks the independent Watchdog whether this exact action, plan and id list was signed off; returns (ok, reason, signed fingerprints).
warden.actions:_check_signoff.detail: Calls watchdog.check_signoff; a missing token or any exception returns not-ok, so no verifiable sign-off means no action.

warden.actions:_run_gated.what: Runs the shared plan-gated loop: freeze check, Watchdog sign-off, plan validation, optional preflight, then per-item freeze, fingerprint recheck and actor call; returns the finished receipt.
warden.actions:_run_gated.detail: Rejects items whose Watchdog-signed fingerprint differs from the plan; a FREEZE created mid-batch skips remaining items; uses plan.validate_request.

warden.actions:_backup_tags.what: Builds the tag set for a volume's backup snapshot: carried original tags plus Warden restore metadata (backup-of, expiry, AZ, type, size, IOPS, throughput, plan id).
warden.actions:_backup_tags.detail: Expiry is now + backup_retention_days; original tags are truncated to stay within the 50-tag AWS limit.

warden.actions:_volume_cost.what: Estimates a volume's monthly USD cost from its type, size, IOPS and throughput via pricing.volume_monthly_usd.
warden.actions:_volume_cost.detail: Defaults to gp2 when the type is missing.

warden.actions:_existing_backup.what: Finds a pending or completed Warden backup snapshot of this volume from an earlier call for the same plan, for reuse.
warden.actions:_existing_backup.detail: Calls DescribeSnapshots filtered by volume-id and tags, then re-verifies VolumeId, backup-of and plan-id so tag-forged snapshots are never reused.

warden.actions:_quarantine_one.what: Backs up one unattached volume to a completed snapshot, re-checks it is still available and unfrozen, deletes it, and returns a result with restore_volume undo.
warden.actions:_quarantine_one.detail: Calls CreateSnapshot, waits snapshot_completed within the call deadline, then DeleteVolume; skips and keeps the volume if backup is incomplete or it was attached meanwhile.

warden.actions:quarantine_volumes.what: Backs up and deletes each approved unused EBS volume through the plan-gated flow, returning a receipt; reversible via restore_volume.
warden.actions:quarantine_volumes.detail: Backs the quarantine_volumes MCP tool; all snapshot waits share CALL_BUDGET_SECONDS=180 so the call answers before the MCP client times out.

warden.actions:_recycle_rules.what: Returns the Recycle Bin retention rules that keep warden:recycle=true snapshots, via scanner.recycle_rules, or an empty list on any error.

warden.actions:_rules_keep.what: Returns True if any Recycle Bin rule would retain this particular snapshot given its own tags.
warden.actions:_rules_keep.detail: Uses scanner.rule_covers, since a snapshot's tags can exclude it from a rule.

warden.actions:_in_recycle_bin.what: Checks whether a snapshot id currently appears in the EC2 Recycle Bin.
warden.actions:_in_recycle_bin.detail: Calls ListSnapshotsInRecycleBin; raises if the API is unavailable.

warden.actions:_untag_recycle.what: Removes Warden's recycle, recycled-at and plan-id tags from a snapshot, ignoring ClientErrors.
warden.actions:_untag_recycle.detail: Calls DeleteTags; used to roll back tagging when a recycle does not proceed.

warden.actions:_recycle_one.what: Tags one snapshot for recycling, waits until the tag is visible, deletes it, then verifies it landed in the Recycle Bin.
warden.actions:_recycle_one.detail: Calls CreateTags, DeleteSnapshot, ListSnapshotsInRecycleBin; untags and keeps the snapshot if the tag is not visible, Warden is frozen, or delete fails.

warden.actions:recycle_snapshots.what: Moves approved snapshots into the Recycle Bin via the plan-gated flow and returns a receipt; reversible via restore_snapshot.
warden.actions:recycle_snapshots.detail: Backs the recycle_snapshots MCP tool; preflight blocks all items if no Recycle Bin rule exists, and snapshots no rule would keep are skipped.

warden.actions:_ami_users.what: Lists self-owned AMI ids whose block device mappings reference the given snapshot.
warden.actions:_ami_users.detail: Calls DescribeImages with Owners=['self']; raises if AMIs cannot be listed.

warden.actions:_delete_snapshot_one.what: Permanently deletes one snapshot after re-checking no AMI uses it and Warden is not frozen, returning the result and savings.
warden.actions:_delete_snapshot_one.detail: Calls DeleteSnapshot with no Recycle Bin copy; fails closed (skips) if AMI usage cannot be checked.

warden.actions:delete_snapshot_permanent.what: Irreversibly deletes exactly one approved snapshot through the plan-gated flow and returns a receipt.
warden.actions:delete_snapshot_permanent.detail: Backs the delete_snapshot_permanently MCP tool; accepts a single snapshot id only.

warden.actions:_state_from.what: Extracts CurrentState.Name for one instance from a StopInstances or StartInstances response list, or None if absent.

warden.actions:_became_active.what: Re-checks an instance's recent CPU and network activity and returns a skip reason if it was busy, else None.
warden.actions:_became_active.detail: Uses scanner._activity over min(idle_lookback_minutes, 15) minutes of CloudWatch metrics; any error returns a reason, so no fresh evidence means no stop.

warden.actions:_stop_one.what: Stops one approved instance after safety checks, tags it stopped-at and plan-id, and returns a result with start_instances undo plus estimated savings.
warden.actions:_stop_one.detail: Skips spot and instance-store-root instances or recently active ones; calls StopInstances then CreateTags; never terminates.

warden.actions:stop_instances.what: Stops approved idle EC2 instances through the plan-gated flow and returns a receipt; reversible via start_instances.
warden.actions:stop_instances.detail: Backs the stop_instances MCP tool; never terminates instances.

warden.actions:_associated.what: Returns True if an Elastic IP has an AssociationId, InstanceId or NetworkInterfaceId.

warden.actions:_quarantine_address_one.what: Tags one unassociated Elastic IP with quarantined-at, quarantined-until and plan-id, confirms the tag is visible, and returns a result with cancel undo.
warden.actions:_quarantine_address_one.detail: Calls CreateTags; window is settings.quarantine_minutes; records quarantined_at/until on the result, which release_address later requires. Releases nothing.

warden.actions:quarantine_addresses.what: Marks approved unassociated Elastic IPs as quarantined through the plan-gated flow and returns a receipt; reversible via cancel_address_quarantine.
warden.actions:quarantine_addresses.detail: Backs the quarantine_addresses MCP tool; this is the required first step before any release.

warden.actions:_release_one.what: Releases one Elastic IP only if unassociated, its quarantine window has passed, a receipt recorded that quarantine, and no DNS record points at it.
warden.actions:_release_one.detail: Calls ReleaseAddress (irreversible); checks audit.quarantine_problem and scanner.dns_references strictly, failing closed; voids the quarantine if seen associated.

warden.actions:release_address.what: Irreversibly releases exactly one approved, quarantined, unassociated Elastic IP through the plan-gated flow and returns a receipt.
warden.actions:release_address.detail: Backs the release_address MCP tool; accepts a single allocation id only.

warden.actions:_check_ids.what: Validates undo-tool ids: a non-empty list of non-empty strings, no wildcards, deduplicated and within the batch limit; returns (ids, problem).
warden.actions:_check_ids.detail: Rejects entries in plan.WILDCARDS or containing '*'.

warden.actions:_run_simple.what: Runs the plan-free undo loop: freeze check, id validation, then per-item freeze check and actor call; returns the finished receipt.
warden.actions:_run_simple.detail: Used by restore and start/cancel tools that need no plan or sign-off; a FREEZE created mid-batch stops the remaining items.

warden.actions:_live_volume.what: Returns True if a volume description exists and its state is not deleting or deleted.

warden.actions:_already_restored.what: Returns the id of a still-existing volume already restored from this backup snapshot, or None, to prevent duplicate restores.
warden.actions:_already_restored.detail: Checks volumes tagged restored-from via DescribeVolumes, then volumes recorded in restore_volume receipts, re-reading each a few times for EC2 lag.

warden.actions:_restore_volume_one.what: Recreates a deleted volume from a completed, in-scope Warden backup snapshot using its recorded AZ, type, size, IOPS, throughput and carried tags.
warden.actions:_restore_volume_one.detail: Calls CreateVolume with tag-on-create restored-from and human-undo marks; refuses non-Warden backups and skips if already restored.

warden.actions:restore_volume.what: Undoes a volume quarantine by recreating the volume from one backup snapshot id, returning a receipt; idempotent if a restored volume already exists.
warden.actions:restore_volume.detail: Backs the restore_volume MCP tool; holds a process-wide _RESTORE_LOCK until the receipt is saved so double Undo clicks cannot both create volumes.

warden.actions:_recycled_by_warden.what: Returns True if a Warden recycle_snapshot receipt shows Warden deleted this snapshot with a restore_snapshot undo.

warden.actions:_restore_snapshot_one.what: Restores one snapshot Warden recycled from the Recycle Bin, removes its recycle tags, and marks it as a human undo.
warden.actions:_restore_snapshot_one.detail: Requires a matching Warden receipt and presence in the bin; calls RestoreSnapshotFromRecycleBin, DeleteTags, CreateTags.

warden.actions:restore_snapshot.what: Undoes a snapshot recycle by restoring one snapshot id from the Recycle Bin and returns a receipt.
warden.actions:restore_snapshot.detail: Backs the restore_snapshot MCP tool; runs through _run_simple with a batch limit of 1.

warden.actions:_start_one.what: Starts one instance only if Warden stopped it (stopped-at tag plus a matching done stop receipt and plan id), then removes the tag and marks human undo.
warden.actions:_start_one.detail: Refuses out-of-scope or not-stopped instances; calls StartInstances, DeleteTags and CreateTags; fails if state is not pending or running.

warden.actions:start_instances.what: Undoes stop_instances by starting a batch of Warden-stopped instances and returns a receipt.
warden.actions:start_instances.detail: Backs the start_instances MCP tool; batch size is limited to settings.max_batch.

warden.actions:_cancel_quarantine_one.what: Removes Warden's quarantine and plan-id tags from one in-scope quarantined Elastic IP and marks it as a human undo.
warden.actions:_cancel_quarantine_one.detail: Calls DeleteTags then CreateTags via _mark_human_undo; skips addresses without a quarantined-until tag.

warden.actions:cancel_address_quarantine.what: Undoes quarantine_addresses for one Elastic IP allocation id so it will not be released, returning a receipt.
warden.actions:cancel_address_quarantine.detail: Backs the cancel_address_quarantine MCP tool; runs through _run_simple with a batch limit of 1.

warden.actions:_quarantine_one.<locals>..what: Re-describes the just-deleted volume and returns True if it is missing or in deleting/deleted state.
warden.actions:_quarantine_one.<locals>..detail: Passed to _settle to confirm the delete took effect.

warden.actions:quarantine_volumes.<local.what: Adapts _quarantine_one to the Actor signature by binding the call's shared snapshot-wait deadline.

warden.actions:_recycle_one.<locals>.tag.what: Re-describes the snapshot and returns True once its warden:recycle tag shows the expected value.
warden.actions:_recycle_one.<locals>.tag.detail: Deletion waits on this because the Recycle Bin rule matches tags AWS sees at delete time.

warden.actions:recycle_snapshots.<locals.what: Loads Recycle Bin rules into the shared list and returns a blocker message if none exist, else None.
warden.actions:recycle_snapshots.<locals.detail: The blocker skips every item and points the caller to delete_snapshot_permanently.

warden.actions:recycle_snapshots.<locals.what: Skips a snapshot no Recycle Bin rule would keep, otherwise hands it to _recycle_one.
warden.actions:recycle_snapshots.<locals.detail: Skipped snapshots reappear on re-scan as irreversible delete_snapshot proposals.

warden.actions:_quarantine_address_one.<.what: Re-describes the Elastic IP and returns True once its quarantined-until tag equals the value just written.
warden.actions:_quarantine_address_one.<.detail: Passed to _settle to confirm the quarantine tag is visible.

warden.scanner:_paginate.what: Collects every item under a response key across all pages of a boto3 call, falling back to a single call when the method cannot paginate.
warden.scanner:_paginate.detail: Uses client.can_paginate and get_paginator; AWS errors propagate to the caller.

warden.scanner:_iso.what: Converts a datetime to a UTC ISO-8601 string ending in Z, treating naive values as UTC; returns None for non-datetime input.

warden.scanner:_age_days.what: Returns how many days old a datetime is relative to now, rounded to one decimal, or None when the value is not a datetime.

warden.scanner:_parse_time.what: Parses an ISO-8601 string (accepting a trailing Z) into a timezone-aware UTC datetime, returning None for empty or invalid text.
warden.scanner:_parse_time.detail: Used to read warden:expires-at and warden:quarantined-until tag values.

warden.scanner:countdown.what: Formats a number of seconds as a human countdown such as '6d 23h 10m', or 'expired' at or below zero.
warden.scanner:countdown.detail: Rounds up to whole minutes with a minimum of 1m.

warden.scanner:_finding.what: Builds a skeleton finding dict for one resource with sanitized tags, age, region, cost slot, fingerprint and safe defaults (verdict keep, no action).
warden.scanner:_finding.detail: Fingerprint comes from plan.fingerprint (sha256 of state-relevant fields); tags pass through sanitize_tags; evidence dry_run starts as 'not run'.

warden.scanner:_set_verdict.what: Sets a finding's verdict and reasons, recording the action and its reversibility only when the verdict is act, and returns the finding.

warden.scanner:_tag_matches.what: Returns True when a Recycle Bin rule tag's ResourceTagKey is present in the tags and its value matches, or the rule value is empty.

warden.scanner:_retention_days.what: Reads a Recycle Bin rule's RetentionPeriod as a number of days, returning 0 when the unit is not DAYS or the value is invalid.

warden.scanner:rule_covers.what: Decides whether a Recycle Bin rule would retain a snapshot with the given tags once Warden adds warden:recycle=true.
warden.scanner:rule_covers.detail: Requires Status available and retention of at least 7 days; tag-level rules need a matching ResourceTag, region-level rules must not match ExcludeResourceTags.

warden.scanner:recycle_rules.what: Lists EBS_SNAPSHOT Recycle Bin rules page by page and returns the full rules that would keep warden:recycle=true snapshots.
warden.scanner:recycle_rules.detail: Calls rbin ListRules and GetRule per rule; returns an empty list on any error such as AccessDenied.

warden.scanner:recycle_bin_ready.what: Returns True when at least one available Recycle Bin rule keeps snapshots tagged warden:recycle=true.
warden.scanner:recycle_bin_ready.detail: Without such a rule, snapshot cleanup becomes a permanent delete_snapshot instead of recycle_snapshot.

warden.scanner:_Context.what: Dataclass holding evidence gathered once per scan: launch template versions and tags, leak sources, snapshot/AMI/template/instance indexes, all volume ids, leak records and first evidence error.
warden.scanner:_Context.detail: Deliberately not scope-filtered; snapshot_evidence_error makes snapshot act verdicts fail closed to review.

warden.scanner:_Context.evidence_failed.what: Takes a failed evidence-listing exception, stores its error code in snapshot_evidence_error if none is set yet, and returns that code.
warden.scanner:_Context.evidence_failed.detail: Once set, _snapshot_finding turns would-be act verdicts on snapshots into review.

warden.scanner:_load_templates.what: Lists all launch templates, stores each template's own tags in the context, and returns their $Default and $Latest versions without duplicates.
warden.scanner:_load_templates.detail: Calls DescribeLaunchTemplates and DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions; failures become notes and are recorded via evidence_failed instead of raising.

warden.scanner:_leak_sources.what: Finds launch template block device mappings with Ebs DeleteOnTermination=false and returns one leak-source record each, including the template's volume tag specifications.
warden.scanner:_leak_sources.detail: Such templates leave an orphaned EBS volume behind whenever an instance launched from them terminates.

warden.scanner:_index_template_snapshots.what: Fills ctx.snapshot_to_templates, mapping each snapshot id to the launch template versions and devices whose block device mappings create disks from it.

warden.scanner:_load_amis.what: Maps snapshot ids to the account's own AMIs that use them, and AMI ids to launch templates referencing them, inside the context.
warden.scanner:_load_amis.detail: Calls DescribeImages with Owners=self; on failure it adds a note and records the error so snapshots are held for review.

warden.scanner:_all_instances.what: Lists every EC2 instance across all reservations, returning an empty list and adding a note if DescribeInstances fails.

warden.scanner:_build_context.what: Builds the per-scan evidence context: launch templates, leak sources, template and AMI snapshot indexes, AMI-to-live-instance map, and the set of all volume ids.
warden.scanner:_build_context.detail: Calls DescribeVolumes unfiltered; terminated and shutting-down instances are left out of the AMI usage map.

warden.scanner:_instance_storage.what: Looks up which instance types support instance-store volumes, calling DescribeInstanceTypes in batches of 100, and returns the map plus any error code.
warden.scanner:_instance_storage.detail: On any error it returns an empty map and the code, so callers fail closed to review.

warden.scanner:_human_undo_reasons.what: Returns a keep reason when a resource carries warden:human-undo-at (or, for volumes, warden:restored-from), meaning a human undid an earlier Warden action.
warden.scanner:_human_undo_reasons.detail: Such resources are never proposed again until those tags are removed.

warden.scanner:_dns_index.what: Builds a map from public IP to Route 53 A/AAAA record labels across every hosted zone in the account.
warden.scanner:_dns_index.detail: Calls ListHostedZones and ListResourceRecordSets; raises on API errors.

warden.scanner:dns_index.what: Public wrapper around _dns_index that returns an empty map on any error, or re-raises the error when strict=True.

warden.scanner:dns_references.what: Returns the Route 53 A/AAAA records whose value equals the given public IP.
warden.scanner:dns_references.detail: Builds the full DNS index on each call; returns an empty list on error unless strict=True.

warden.scanner:_private_ip_index.what: Maps every private IP of each non-terminated instance, including all network interface private addresses, to its instance id.
warden.scanner:_private_ip_index.detail: Calls DescribeInstances; raises on API errors.

warden.scanner:_lb_index.what: Maps instance ids to the ELBv2 target group names they are registered in, resolving ip-type targets to instances through private IPs.
warden.scanner:_lb_index.detail: Calls DescribeTargetGroups and DescribeTargetHealth; builds the private-IP index only when needed; raises on API errors.

warden.scanner:lb_target_instances.what: Public wrapper around _lb_index returning instance id to target group names, or an empty map on any error unless strict=True.

warden.scanner:_has_env_tag.what: Returns True when the tags include a non-empty env, environment or stage key, compared case-insensitively.

warden.scanner:_prod_guard.what: Downgrades an act or review finding to review when its Name tag or Description looks like production (prod, prd, production, live) and no env tag exists.
warden.scanner:_prod_guard.detail: Never overrides a keep verdict; the untagged-production reason is placed first.

warden.scanner:_match_leak.what: Finds the leak source that produced a volume, matching by aws:ec2launchtemplate:id tag or template volume tags, preferring one with the same size.
warden.scanner:_match_leak.detail: Returns None when no leaky template matches.

warden.scanner:_leak_record.what: Builds a report record for a leaky launch template device with the problem text, a fix description and a ready-made create-launch-template-version CLI command.
warden.scanner:_leak_record.detail: The CLI sets DeleteOnTermination=true but Warden never runs it; orphaned_volume_ids starts empty.

warden.scanner:_standing_leaks.what: Adds leak records for in-scope leaky launch templates that have no orphaned volume right now, one per template and device.
warden.scanner:_standing_leaks.detail: Keeps a leak visible after its orphaned disks are cleaned up; scope is checked against the template's own tags.

warden.scanner:_volume_finding.what: Evaluates one in-scope unattached EBS volume: prices it, links it to any leaking launch template, and proposes quarantine_volume unless keep or human-undo reasons apply.
warden.scanner:_volume_finding.detail: Adds warnings for gp2 volumes and for KMS-encrypted volumes, whose restore needs the Warden identity to use the key.

warden.scanner:_ami_chain.what: Describes each AMI that uses a snapshot as a chain string, extended with the launch templates and live instances that use that AMI.

warden.scanner:_is_shared.what: Returns True when a snapshot has createVolumePermission entries, meaning it is shared with other accounts.

warden.scanner:_snapshot_finding.what: Evaluates one owned snapshot: keeps it if protected, used by an AMI or launch template, incomplete, shared or a live backup, otherwise proposes recycle_snapshot or delete_snapshot.
warden.scanner:_snapshot_finding.detail: Fails closed to review on evidence errors or backups lacking a valid expiry tag; delete_snapshot (no covering Recycle Bin rule) carries an irreversible warning.

warden.scanner:metric_period.what: Computes a CloudWatch period in seconds for a lookback window: at least 300, at most 1440 datapoints, and a multiple CloudWatch accepts for that age.
warden.scanner:metric_period.detail: Step is 60 s up to 15 days, 300 s up to 63 days, 3600 s beyond.

warden.scanner:_metric.what: Fetches one AWS/EC2 CloudWatch metric statistic for an instance over a time window and returns the datapoint values as floats.
warden.scanner:_metric.detail: Calls GetMetricStatistics with the InstanceId dimension.

warden.scanner:_activity.what: Measures an instance's max CPU and network bytes per hour over the lookback window, skipping the first 10 minutes after launch, with datapoint counts.
warden.scanner:_activity.detail: Queries CPUUtilization Maximum and NetworkIn/NetworkOut Sum; returns no metrics plus a note when under 5 minutes are observable.

warden.scanner:_stop_protected.what: Returns True when an instance has stop protection (disableApiStop) enabled.

warden.scanner:_instance_store_problem.what: Returns a reason to hold an instance for review when its type has instance-store volumes or that could not be checked, otherwise None.
warden.scanner:_instance_store_problem.detail: Unknown storage status counts as a problem, so the check fails closed.

warden.scanner:_instance_finding.what: Evaluates one running in-scope instance and proposes stop_instance only when CloudWatch shows it idle with enough datapoints and no protection applies.
warden.scanner:_instance_finding.detail: Keeps load-balancer targets, spot, instance-store root and DisableApiStop instances; missing or thin metrics or instance-store volumes yield review.

warden.scanner:_address_finding.what: Evaluates one unassociated Elastic IP: keeps it if a DNS record points at it, proposes quarantine_address first, and release_address only after a finished, receipt-backed quarantine.
warden.scanner:_address_finding.detail: Associated quarantined IPs trigger record_quarantine_void; quarantine_problem checks the audit receipt; unreadable Route 53 yields review; release carries an irreversible warning.

warden.scanner:_first_problem.what: Returns 'would_succeed' only if every dry-run result would succeed, otherwise the first result that is not a success.

warden.scanner:_dry_run_call.what: Runs the AWS DryRun calls matching a finding's proposed action and returns a single result string such as would_succeed, denied or error.
warden.scanner:_dry_run_call.detail: Probes CreateSnapshot+DeleteVolume, CreateTags+DeleteSnapshot, DeleteSnapshot, StopInstances, CreateTags or ReleaseAddress with DryRun=True; nothing is changed.

warden.scanner:_apply_dry_runs.what: Dry-runs every act finding and downgrades it to review when AWS denies the action or does not confirm it would succeed.
warden.scanner:_apply_dry_runs.detail: Stores the result in evidence.dry_run and appends the denial or error to the reasons.

warden.scanner:_lookup_owner.what: Finds who created a resource from its recent CloudTrail events, preferring Create/Run/Allocate/Copy/Import/Register events, and returns the creator and event.
warden.scanner:_lookup_owner.detail: Calls LookupEvents (MaxResults=5) and picks the last matching event; falls back to the userIdentity ARN; on error returns a note plus internal _code.

warden.scanner:_apply_owners.what: Attaches a CloudTrail creator to act findings, then review findings, caching per resource and respecting owner_lookup_limit and half the scan time budget.
warden.scanner:_apply_owners.detail: A non-throttling CloudTrail error marks all later lookups as skipped for this scan; the budget uses the patchable _clock.

warden.scanner:_tier.what: Maps a finding to a human-facing tier: protected for keep, safe_reversible for a reversible act, needs_review otherwise.

warden.scanner:_age_phrase.what: Returns a phrase such as ' 12 days ago' or ' less than a day ago' from a finding's age_days, or an empty string.

warden.scanner:_why_act.what: Returns a one-sentence plain-English explanation of why Warden proposes a finding's action, worded per action type and for leaked volumes.
warden.scanner:_why_act.detail: The quarantine_address text includes the configured quarantine length formatted by countdown.

warden.scanner:_why_review.what: Returns a one-sentence plain-English explanation of why a finding needs human review, based on which known reason it carries.

warden.scanner:_why_keep.what: Returns a one-sentence plain-English explanation of why Warden leaves a finding alone, based on its first reason.

warden.scanner:_apply_tiers.what: Adds a tier and a one-sentence why explanation to every finding, choosing the keep, act or review explainer by verdict.

warden.scanner:_decision_list.what: Returns up to 10 resource ids for a human to decide on: needs_review first, then safe_reversible, each sorted by monthly cost descending.

warden.scanner:_decision_list.<locals>.o.what: Returns the findings in one tier sorted by est_monthly_usd descending, treating a missing cost as zero.

warden.scanner:_summary.what: Builds scan summary counts: act/keep/review verdicts, reversible and irreversible actions, estimated monthly savings, per-tier counts and the decision list.

warden.scanner:_evaluate.what: Runs a finding builder on each resource, collecting non-None findings and turning any exception into a skipped-resource note.
warden.scanner:_evaluate.detail: Isolates per-resource failures so one bad resource does not abort the scan.

warden.scanner:_list.what: Calls a listing function and returns its result, or an empty list plus a note when it raises.

warden.scanner:scan.what: Scans one region for idle volumes, snapshots, instances and Elastic IPs, saves a Plan of every finding, audits the scan, and returns the report.
warden.scanner:scan.detail: Read-only on AWS; applies prod guard, dry runs, CloudTrail owners and tiers; writes the plan file and a scan audit entry with per-finding results.

warden.console:_srv.what: Lazily imports and returns the warden.server module, avoiding a circular import because server imports console to register its routes.

warden.console:clear_cache.what: Resets the module-level rollback-window cache (settings, clients, timestamp, value) while holding the cache lock.
warden.console:clear_cache.detail: Used by tests to force a fresh watchdog.rollback_window computation.

warden.console:_err.what: Formats an exception as 'TypeName: message' for use in JSON error fields.

warden.console:_guard.what: Calls fn(*args) and returns its result, or {'error': 'Type: message'} if it raises, so a failing console section becomes JSON rather than a traceback.

warden.console:_hostname.what: Normalizes a Host header value to a lowercase hostname, dropping any port while keeping bracketed IPv6 literals such as [::1] intact.

warden.console:host_allowed.what: Returns True for non-loopback binds; on a loopback bind, only accepts Host headers naming 127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1] or host.docker.internal.
warden.console:host_allowed.detail: DNS-rebinding guard checked by every console route; a missing Host header is rejected on loopback binds.

warden.console:_bind_host.what: Returns the configured bind host from warden.server._context() settings, falling back to 127.0.0.1 when the config cannot be loaded.
warden.console:_bind_host.detail: The fallback keeps the Host guard strict when configuration is unknown.

warden.console:read_last_scan.what: Reads and parses last_scan.json from settings.state_dir; returns None if missing, or an error dict if unreadable or not a JSON object.

warden.console:_views.what: Derives console view data from the last scan: action/type labels, refused 'keep' findings with refusal kind and tone, a Warden-backup count, and plan expiry.
warden.console:_views.detail: Findings with reasons starting 'Warden backup of' count as backups, not refusals; 'suspicious' reasons get tone danger. Plan expiry comes from plan.load_plan.

warden.console:_status.what: Builds the status section: account id, region, scope, MOCK/REAL mode, mock endpoint, freeze flag, quarantine minutes, max batch and plan TTL.
warden.console:_status.detail: If clients.account_id() raises, records account_error and falls back to the scan's account_id.

warden.console:_receipts.what: Lists up to 20 recent receipt summaries via audit.list_receipts and loads full details for the newest 5, dropping ui, ui_error and proof_command keys.

warden.console:_rollback.what: Returns watchdog.rollback_window output minus presentation keys, stamped with computed_at, cached for 10 seconds per identical settings and clients objects.
warden.console:_rollback.detail: rollback_window performs AWS describe calls; any exception is stored as {'error': ...} and cached like a normal result.

warden.console:_resource_ids.what: Collects unique resource id strings from a ledger entry's resource_id, resource_ids, approved_ids, blocked keys and results[].resource_id, preserving first-seen order.

warden.console:_resource_ids.<locals>.ad.what: Appends a value to the enclosing ids list when it is a non-empty string not already present.

warden.console:_entry_view.what: Converts a raw ledger entry into a compact display dict with seq, event, 12-char hashes, a link_ok chain check, up to 6 resource ids, and selected fields.
warden.console:_entry_view.detail: link_ok compares prev_hash to the preceding entry's hash, or audit.GENESIS for the first; detail and reason are truncated to 240 characters.

warden.console:_ledger.what: Runs audit.verify_ledger, then streams audit.jsonl counting events and done action_items, keeping the last 25 entries as views, newest first.
warden.console:_ledger.detail: Unparseable lines appear as 'unreadable_line' entries and reset chain linking; a missing ledger file yields empty results.

warden.console:build_state.what: Assembles the console JSON snapshot (server_time, status, last_scan, views, receipts, rollback, ledger), wrapping each section so failures become error dicts; never raises.
warden.console:build_state.detail: If server._context() fails, returns only a status error plus a hint from server._hint.

warden.console:_finite.what: Recursively replaces non-finite floats (NaN, Infinity) with None across dicts, lists and tuples, converting dict keys to strings.

warden.console:_dumps.what: Serializes a state dict to strict JSON (allow_nan=False, default=str), retrying after _finite sanitization when non-finite floats are present.

warden.console:_misdirected.what: Returns a 421 'Invalid Host header' response carrying the console's no-store and security headers.
warden.console:_misdirected.detail: Sent when host_allowed rejects a request's Host header.

warden.console:_tags.what: Converts an AWS Tags list of {Key, Value} dicts into a plain string-to-string dict, ignoring non-dict items.

warden.console:_is_demo.what: Returns True when the tags dict has warden:demo set to 'true' (whitespace-stripped, case-insensitive).

warden.console:_key_tags.what: Formats up to 5 'key=value' strings, each capped at 120 characters, from a tags dict, excluding the demo tag and Name.

warden.console:build_simulator.what: In mock mode, lists demo-tagged volumes, snapshots, live instances, Elastic IPs, launch templates and AMIs from moto; in real mode returns only an explanatory note.
warden.console:build_simulator.detail: Read-only EC2 describe calls, each list wrapped by _guard; includes endpoint, moto dashboard URL (endpoint + /moto-api/), region and server_time.

warden.console:build_simulator.<locals>..what: Calls ec2.describe_volumes filtered by the demo tag and returns id, name, size, type, state, AZ, attached instance ids and key tags per volume.
Calls ec2.describe_snapshots for self-owned, demo-tagged snapshots and returns id, name, size, state, source volume id and key tags.
Calls ec2.describe_instances filtered by the demo tag, skips terminated instances, and returns id, name, instance type, state and key tags.
Calls ec2.describe_addresses filtered by the demo tag and returns allocation id, name, public IP, association flag and key tags.
Calls ec2.describe_launch_templates and keeps demo-tagged templates, returning id, name, default version number and key tags.
warden.console:build_simulator.<locals>..detail: Filters client-side with _is_demo instead of an API tag filter.

warden.console:build_simulator.<locals>..what: Calls ec2.describe_images for self-owned AMIs, keeps demo-tagged ones, and returns id, name, state, backing EBS snapshot ids and key tags.
warden.console:build_simulator.<locals>..detail: Filters client-side with _is_demo instead of an API tag filter.

warden.console:console_page.what: Async handler for GET /console: rejects disallowed Host headers with 421, otherwise returns the self-contained HTML PAGE with security headers and a strict CSP.
warden.console:console_page.detail: Headers include Cache-Control no-store, nosniff, no-referrer, X-Frame-Options DENY, and CSP with object-src/base-uri/form-action/frame-ancestors 'none'.

warden.console:console_state.what: Async handler for GET /console/api/state: after the Host check, runs build_state in a threadpool and returns the result as no-store JSON.
warden.console:console_state.detail: The embedded page polls this route every 5 seconds.

warden.console:console_simulator.what: Async handler for GET /console/api/simulator: after the Host check, runs build_simulator in a threadpool and returns the result as no-store JSON.

warden.console:register.what: Adds the three GET-only console routes to an MCP server via mcp.custom_route, skipping paths already registered so repeated calls are idempotent.
warden.console:register.detail: Routes are registered with include_in_schema=False; the existing path set is read from mcp._custom_starlette_routes.

warden.ui:_q.what: Converts any value to a bounded OpenUI string literal: control characters become spaces, text over limit is truncated with an ellipsis, and backslashes and quotes are escaped.
warden.ui:_q.detail: The injection defense for OpenUI output: untrusted tag text cannot break out of a string literal.

warden.ui:_arr.what: Joins already-formatted items into an OpenUI array literal of the form [a, b, ...].

warden.ui:_money.what: Formats a value as a dollar string with thousands separators and two decimals, or 'n/a' if it is not numeric.

warden.ui:_num.what: Formats a value as a two-decimal number string, or '0' if it is not numeric.

warden.ui:_tag.what: Builds an OpenUI Tag(...) expression with escaped text, small size and the given color variant.

warden.ui:_kpi.what: Builds an OpenUI assignment defining a KPI Card from a small label, a large-heavy value and a small note, all escaped via _q.

warden.ui:_mode_callout.what: Returns an OpenUI warning Callout statement explaining simulated AWS mock mode when mock is true, otherwise None.

warden.ui:_program.what: Assembles a full OpenUI program: a root column Stack of the given child names followed by the definition lines, joined with newlines.

warden.ui:_savings_by_type.what: Sums est_monthly_usd per resource-type label (Disk, Snapshot, Server, Public IP) and returns quoted labels and formatted values sorted by descending total.
warden.ui:_savings_by_type.detail: Feeds the SingleStackedBarChart on the scan dashboard's Savings tab.

warden.ui:scan_ui.what: Turns a scan report into an OpenUI dashboard: header, optional mock callout, five KPI cards, a decision table, and tabs for how-it-works, savings, leaks, why-safe and refused.
warden.ui:scan_ui.detail: Shows 'approve ...' commands to type instead of buttons; excludes Warden's own backups from refusals; appends the console URL when given.

warden.ui:_refusal_kind.what: Maps a kept finding's reasons text to a refusal label such as 'Prompt-injection attempt', 'Production' or 'Managed by code' by first matching keyword.
warden.ui:_refusal_kind.detail: Returns 'Protected' when no keyword matches; also used by console._views to classify refusals.

warden.ui:watchdog_ui.what: Builds an OpenUI view of a Watchdog result: a sign-off or blocked callout, up to 10 recorded checks as steps, and a table of blocked ids with reasons.
warden.ui:watchdog_ui.detail: The success callout states the action, that the sign-off is single-use and HMAC-signed, and its expiry.

warden.ui:receipt_ui.what: Builds an OpenUI view of an action receipt: a done/skipped/failed summary callout with estimated savings, a per-resource results table with undo commands, and a hint.
warden.ui:receipt_ui.detail: The callout is 'success' only when at least one item is done and none failed; the hint suggests 'show rollback window' and the console URL.

warden.ui:rollback_ui.what: Builds an OpenUI view of the rollback window: a ledger-integrity callout, a table of items with state, countdown, flags and undo command, and an optional console link.
warden.ui:rollback_ui.detail: Expired countdowns are tagged danger; with no items it shows 'Nothing is waiting in a rollback window.'

warden.server:_save_last_scan.what: Writes the scan report, minus the ui, ui_error and proof_command keys, atomically to state_dir/last_scan.json for the read-only console.
warden.server:_save_last_scan.detail: Best effort: uses audit.write_json_atomic and silently ignores OSError.

warden.server:_console_url.what: Returns the console URL http://<host>:<port>/console, substituting 127.0.0.1 when the server binds to 0.0.0.0, :: or an empty host.

warden.server:_resolve_name.what: Maps a resource Name tag to its resource id by case-insensitive match against findings in last_scan.json; strings already shaped like AWS ids pass through.
warden.server:_resolve_name.detail: Id regex covers vol, snap, i, eipalloc, ami and lt prefixes. Returns the input unchanged if the file is unreadable or nothing matches.

warden.server:_with_ui.what: Adds a 'ui' dashboard string, built by the given builder function, to a result dict unless the result contains an 'error' key.
warden.server:_with_ui.detail: Builder exceptions are caught and stored as 'ui_error' so presentation never breaks the data path.

warden.server:configure.what: Sets, or resets when called with no arguments, the module-level shared Settings and AwsClients under a lock; used by main() and tests.

warden.server:_context.what: Returns the shared (Settings, AwsClients) pair, lazily calling load_settings() and constructing AwsClients on first use under a lock.

warden.server:_hint.what: Maps an exception to a remediation hint for missing credentials, missing region, invalid config, access denied, expired credentials, or a generic retry/preflight suggestion.
warden.server:_hint.detail: Classifies botocore errors with aws.error_code: UnauthorizedOperation, AccessDenied*, ExpiredToken, ExpiredTokenException, InvalidClientTokenId, AuthFailure.

warden.server:_run.what: Resolves the shared context and runs a tool body with (settings, clients), returning its dict or an {'error', 'hint'} dict if anything raises.
warden.server:_run.detail: Catches every Exception so MCP tools always answer with JSON, never a stack trace.

warden.server:_ids.what: Wraps a single id string in a one-item list and returns any other value unchanged; validation is left to actions and plan.

warden.server:warden_status.what: MCP tool that reports account, AWS mode, region, scope, freeze state, batch limit, idle thresholds, TTLs, Recycle Bin readiness, ledger integrity and approval rules.
warden.server:warden_status.detail: Read-only (_READ annotations); no gate required. Delegates to its nested body through _run.

warden.server:scan_for_waste.what: MCP tool that scans in-scope EBS volumes, snapshots, idle EC2 instances and unassociated Elastic IPs, returning findings, verdicts, savings, leaks and a plan_id.
warden.server:scan_for_waste.detail: Read-only (_READ); no gate. The returned plan_id is required by every plan-gated executor tool.

warden.server:get_plan.what: MCP tool that returns a saved plan (items, verdicts, actions, expiry) for a plan_id, plus whether it has expired.
warden.server:get_plan.detail: Read-only (_READ); reads local state only, no AWS calls.

warden.server:get_receipt.what: MCP tool that returns the stored receipt of a past Warden action by receipt_id: per-item results, undo instructions and savings.

warden.server:list_receipts.what: MCP tool that lists recent Warden action receipts newest first (receipt_id, action, plan_id, finished_at, counts), up to limit entries.

warden.server:_parse_iso.what: Parses an ISO-8601 string (trailing Z allowed) into a timezone-aware UTC datetime; returns None for empty or unparsable input.

warden.server:_backup_entry.what: Converts a Warden backup snapshot description into a summary dict with original volume, state, size, created/expiry times, expired flag, restore AZ/type, plan_id and restore hint.
warden.server:_backup_entry.detail: Reads tags TAG_BACKUP_OF, TAG_EXPIRES_AT, TAG_RESTORE_AZ, TAG_RESTORE_TYPE and TAG_PLAN_ID; restore_hint points to restore_volume.

warden.server:list_warden_backups.what: MCP tool that lists the backup snapshots Warden took before deleting volumes, with original volume id, expiry and restore_volume instructions.

warden.server:watchdog_verify.what: MCP tool that runs the independent Watchdog check for (plan_id, action, resource_ids) and returns checks, blocked reasons, approved_ids and a single-use signoff token.
warden.server:watchdog_verify.detail: Annotated read-only (_READ): changes no AWS resources but writes a sign-off record and ledger entry. Its token is the signoff every plan-gated executor requires.

warden.server:rollback_window.what: MCP tool that lists every Warden change still undoable, with per-item countdown, undo tool and args, finalize notes, flags and the ledger integrity check.
warden.server:rollback_window.detail: Read-only (_READ); delegates to watchdog.rollback_window and attaches ui.rollback_ui.

warden.server:resource_history.what: MCP tool that answers 'what happened to X?' with newest-first hash-chained ledger entries mentioning the resource, plus the ledger integrity check.
warden.server:resource_history.detail: Read-only (_READ); makes no AWS calls. Accepts a Name tag, resolved to an id via the last scan.

warden.server:quarantine_volumes.what: MCP tool that, for 1..max_batch planned volume ids, takes a backup snapshot of each, waits for it to complete, then deletes the volume.
warden.server:quarantine_volumes.detail: Destructive (_DESTRUCTIVE annotations), undoable via restore_volume. Requires 'act' ids from the plan, a single-use watchdog signoff token and human approval.

warden.server:recycle_snapshots.what: MCP tool that tags 1..max_batch planned snapshots for the Warden Recycle Bin rule and deletes them, restorable during retention.
warden.server:recycle_snapshots.detail: Destructive (_DESTRUCTIVE), reversible for 7 days via restore_snapshot. Requires plan action recycle_snapshot, a single-use watchdog signoff token and human approval.

warden.server:delete_snapshot_permanentl.what: MCP tool that permanently deletes exactly one planned snapshot, used only when the Recycle Bin rule is missing.
warden.server:delete_snapshot_permanentl.detail: IRREVERSIBLE (_DESTRUCTIVE). Requires plan action delete_snapshot, a single-use watchdog signoff token and explicit human approval.

warden.server:stop_instances.what: MCP tool that stops, never terminates, 1..max_batch idle planned instances; undo with start_instances.
warden.server:stop_instances.detail: Reversible (_REVERSIBLE, destructiveHint false). Requires plan action stop_instance, a single-use watchdog signoff token and human approval.

warden.server:release_address.what: MCP tool that releases exactly one unassociated Elastic IP whose quarantine window has ended.
warden.server:release_address.detail: IRREVERSIBLE (_DESTRUCTIVE); the public IP may not be recoverable. Requires plan action release_address, a single-use watchdog signoff token and explicit human approval.

warden.server:quarantine_addresses.what: MCP tool that tags 1..max_batch unassociated planned Elastic IPs as quarantined for the quarantine window without releasing them.
warden.server:quarantine_addresses.detail: Reversible (_REVERSIBLE); undo with cancel_address_quarantine. Requires plan action quarantine_address, a single-use watchdog signoff token and human approval.

warden.server:restore_volume.what: MCP tool that recreates a volume from one Warden backup snapshot in its original AZ with its original type and tags; the new volume is not attached.
warden.server:restore_volume.detail: Undo tool (_REVERSIBLE); needs human approval but takes no plan_id or watchdog signoff.

warden.server:restore_snapshot.what: MCP tool that restores one snapshot Warden moved to the Recycle Bin, while it is still within retention.
warden.server:restore_snapshot.detail: Undo tool (_REVERSIBLE); needs human approval but takes no plan_id or watchdog signoff.

warden.server:start_instances.what: MCP tool that starts 1..max_batch in-scope instances that Warden stopped (tagged warden:stopped-at and recorded in a stop receipt).
warden.server:start_instances.detail: Undo tool (_REVERSIBLE); needs human approval but no plan or signoff. Instances Warden did not stop are refused.

warden.server:cancel_address_quarantine.what: MCP tool that removes Warden's quarantine tags from one Elastic IP carrying warden:quarantined-until so it is no longer proposed for release.
warden.server:cancel_address_quarantine.detail: Undo tool (_REVERSIBLE); needs human approval but no plan or signoff.

warden.server:_transport_security.what: Returns DNS-rebinding protection settings allowing loopback and host.docker.internal hosts and origins when bound to loopback; returns None for any other host.

warden.server:main.what: Loads settings, configures shared state, prints mock-mode and startup banners, then runs the MCP server over streamable HTTP at http://<host>:<port>/mcp.
warden.server:main.detail: Invalid settings raise SystemExit('Warden config error: ...'). Transport security comes from _transport_security(settings.host).

warden.server:warden_status.<locals>.bod.what: Builds the status dict from Settings and audit.verify_ledger, then adds the account id and Recycle Bin readiness, returning early with aws_error and hint on failure.
warden.server:warden_status.<locals>.bod.detail: Calls clients.account_id() and scanner.recycle_bin_ready(clients); freeze comes from is_frozen(settings).

warden.server:scan_for_waste.<locals>.bo.what: Runs scanner.scan, attaches the scan dashboard and proof_command script, saves the report via _save_last_scan, and returns it.
warden.server:scan_for_waste.<locals>.bo.detail: Dashboard built by ui.scan_ui with the mock flag and console URL.

warden.server:get_plan.<locals>.body.what: Loads the plan with plan.load_plan and returns its dict plus an 'expired' flag, or an error with a rescan hint if not found.

warden.server:get_receipt.<locals>.body.what: Loads the receipt with audit.load_receipt and returns it, or an error dict pointing to list_receipts when the id is unknown.

warden.server:list_receipts.<locals>.bod.what: Clamps limit to 1..200 and returns {'receipts': audit.list_receipts(settings, limit)}.

warden.server:list_warden_backups.<local.what: Paginates self-owned snapshots tagged with TAG_BACKUP_OF, converts each via _backup_entry, and returns them newest first with region and count.
warden.server:list_warden_backups.<local.detail: boto3 ec2 describe_snapshots paginator with OwnerIds=['self'] and a tag-key filter.

warden.server:watchdog_verify.<locals>.b.what: Calls watchdog.verify with normalized ids, attaches the watchdog dashboard, renames 'token' to 'signoff' and removes 'signoff_id' from the result.
warden.server:watchdog_verify.<locals>.b.detail: The bare signoff_id is hidden because a model once passed it instead of the full token.

warden.server:resource_history.<locals>..what: Clamps limit to 1..500, resolves a Name tag to an id, fetches matching audit.history entries, and returns them with asked_for, count and ledger check.
warden.server:resource_history.<locals>..detail: No AWS calls; integrity comes from audit.verify_ledger.

warden.watchdog:_now.what: Returns the given timestamp as a float, or time.time() when None, so callers and tests can inject the current time.

warden.watchdog:_iso.what: Formats epoch seconds as a UTC ISO-8601 string ending in Z.

warden.watchdog:_parse_epoch.what: Converts an ISO-8601 string (Z allowed) or datetime to epoch seconds, treating naive values as UTC; returns None for other or unparsable input.

warden.watchdog:countdown.what: Formats remaining seconds as '6d 23h 10m', '2h 5m' or '4m 12s', or 'expired' when zero or negative.

warden.watchdog:_canonical.what: Serializes a dict to canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and str fallback, used as the HMAC input.

warden.watchdog:_requested.what: Normalizes requested ids (list, tuple or scalar) to a de-duplicated list of stripped non-empty strings, or ['*'] when none remain.

warden.watchdog:_new_signoff_id.what: Generates a sign-off id of the form wd-<UTC yyyymmddTHHMMSS>-<6 hex chars>.

warden.watchdog:_signoffs_dir.what: Returns the path state_dir/signoffs, where sign-off records and their .consumed markers are stored.

warden.watchdog:_load_key.what: Returns the 32-byte HMAC key from state_dir/watchdog.key, creating it with secrets.token_bytes when create is True; returns None if unavailable.
warden.watchdog:_load_key.detail: Creation is race-safe under a thread lock: temp file chmod 0600, hard-linked into place (os.replace fallback), then re-read and length-checked.

warden.watchdog:_mac.what: Computes the hex HMAC-SHA256 of a sign-off record's canonical JSON with the given key.

warden.watchdog:_account.what: Returns the AWS account id from clients.account_id(), or 'unknown' if the lookup raises.

warden.watchdog:_not_found.what: Returns True when an exception's AWS error code ends in 'NotFound' or '.Malformed'.

warden.watchdog:_describe.what: Re-describes one volume, snapshot, address or non-terminated instance by id with the watchdog's own EC2 calls; returns the resource dict or None if missing.
warden.watchdog:_describe.detail: Calls describe_volumes, describe_snapshots, describe_addresses or describe_instances; NotFound/Malformed errors yield None, other errors propagate.

warden.watchdog:_ami_users.what: Returns ids of self-owned AMIs whose block device mappings reference the snapshot, caching the image list once per verify call.
warden.watchdog:_ami_users.detail: ec2 describe_images with Owners=['self'], paginated when possible; errors propagate so the caller fails closed.

warden.watchdog:_template_users.what: Returns 'name (id)' labels of launch templates whose $Default or $Latest version creates a disk from the snapshot, using a cached snapshot index.
warden.watchdog:_template_users.detail: Calls describe_launch_templates and describe_launch_template_versions; errors propagate so the caller fails closed.

warden.watchdog:_dns_refs.what: Returns the Route 53 records pointing at an IP, building a cached DNS index once per verify call; returns an empty list when no IP.
warden.watchdog:_dns_refs.detail: Uses scanner.dns_index(strict=True) so a Route 53 failure raises and blocks instead of reading as no records.

warden.watchdog:_associated.what: Returns True if an Elastic IP description has an AssociationId, InstanceId or NetworkInterfaceId.

warden.watchdog:_action_check.what: Runs the action-specific safety checks for one described resource and returns (block reason or None, human-readable check lines).
warden.watchdog:_action_check.detail: Volume unattached; snapshot completed, unused by AMIs/launch templates; instance running, not an LB target; address unassociated, quarantine ended and receipt-matched, no DNS record. Fails closed.

warden.watchdog:_check_item.what: Re-describes a plan item and blocks it if missing, out of scope, carrying keep/protection tags, fingerprint-changed or failing _action_check; otherwise returns check lines.
warden.watchdog:_check_item.detail: Compares plan.fingerprint of the live resource with the fingerprint stored in the plan.

warden.watchdog:verify.what: Independently re-checks a (plan_id, action, resource_ids) request and issues a single-use HMAC sign-off token for passing ids; returns approved_ids, blocked, checks and expiry.
warden.watchdog:verify.detail: Blocks everything when frozen or the plan is invalid; per-item errors fail closed. Writes signoffs/<id>.json and a watchdog_signoff or watchdog_block ledger entry.

warden.watchdog:check_signoff.what: Validates and consumes a sign-off token for (plan_id, action, resource_ids), returning (ok, reason, fingerprints of the requested ids) to the executor.
warden.watchdog:check_signoff.detail: Checks format, record, HMAC via compare_digest, expiry, plan, action and approved ids; enforces single use with an O_EXCL .consumed file; logs consumed or rejected.

warden.watchdog:_window_item.what: Builds one rollback-window entry with state, since/until times, seconds remaining, countdown text, undo tool, finalize note, flags and any extra fields.
warden.watchdog:_window_item.detail: until=None means no deadline: seconds_remaining 0 and countdown 'no deadline'.

warden.watchdog:_restored.what: Reads restore_volume receipts and returns a map from backup snapshot id to the volume Warden restored from it.
warden.watchdog:_restored.detail: Scans up to 100,000 receipts via audit.list_receipts and audit.load_receipt.

warden.watchdog:_backups.what: Lists in-scope Warden backup snapshots as rollback items with expiry countdown and restore_volume undo, flagging bad or past expiry, incomplete or already-restored backups.
warden.watchdog:_backups.detail: ec2 describe_snapshots (self, tag-key TAG_BACKUP_OF). Undo is None once restored, to avoid creating a duplicate volume.

warden.watchdog:_recycled.what: Finds snapshots recycled according to receipts and returns rollback items with Recycle Bin exit-time countdowns and restore_snapshot undo.
warden.watchdog:_recycled.detail: Calls list_snapshots_in_recycle_bin; on API error estimates 7 days. Skips snapshots already restored; flags ones whose retention ended as unrecoverable.

warden.watchdog:_stopped.what: Lists in-scope, non-terminated instances tagged TAG_STOPPED_AT as rollback items with no deadline, offering start_instances undo only while stopped.
warden.watchdog:_stopped.detail: ec2 describe_instances with a tag-key filter; flags instances restarted outside Warden or in transitional states.

warden.watchdog:_quarantined.what: Lists in-scope Elastic IPs tagged TAG_QUARANTINED_UNTIL as rollback items with countdown, cancel_address_quarantine undo and a release_address finalize note.
warden.watchdog:_quarantined.detail: ec2 describe_addresses; an address seen associated again gets a quarantine void recorded in the ledger and a flag.

warden.watchdog:rollback_window.what: Collects backups, recycled snapshots, stopped instances and quarantined Elastic IPs into one list sorted by deadline, with notes and the ledger integrity check.
warden.watchdog:rollback_window.detail: A failing source is reported in notes instead of aborting the whole call; items without a deadline sort last.

warden.watchdog:verify.<locals>.finish.what: Writes a watchdog_signoff ledger entry if any ids were approved, otherwise a watchdog_block entry, then returns the result dict.

warden.watchdog:check_signoff.<locals>.r.what: Records a watchdog_signoff_rejected ledger entry with the reason and returns (False, reason, {}).

warden.audit:_utcnow.what: Returns the current time as a timezone-aware UTC datetime.

warden.audit:iso_now.what: Returns the current UTC time as an ISO-8601 string with a Z suffix, such as 2026-09-26T12:03:01Z.

warden.audit:new_id.what: Builds a new id from a prefix, a UTC timestamp and six random hex characters, such as plan-20260926T120301-3fa2c1.
warden.audit:new_id.detail: Only the prefixes 'plan' and 'rcpt' are allowed; any other prefix raises ValueError.

warden.audit:write_json_atomic.what: Writes data as indented JSON to a path by writing a hidden temp file and renaming it over the target; returns the path.
warden.audit:write_json_atomic.detail: Creates parent folders; os.replace makes the swap atomic, so readers never see a half-written file.

warden.audit:_ledger_path.what: Returns the ledger file path, state_dir/audit.jsonl.

warden.audit:_canonical.what: Serialises an entry to canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) so the same entry always hashes the same way.

warden.audit:_entry_hash.what: Computes sha256 of the previous entry's hash plus the canonical JSON of this entry with its own hash field removed.
warden.audit:_entry_hash.detail: This is the chain link: changing any field, or any earlier entry, changes every later hash.

warden.audit:_last_chained.what: Reads the ledger backwards in 8 KB chunks and returns (seq, hash) of the last chained entry, or (0, GENESIS) if there is none.
warden.audit:_last_chained.detail: Skips torn or non-JSON lines; a legacy unhashed tail or an unreadable file restarts the chain at GENESIS.

warden.audit:_head_behind.what: Returns True when the ledger no longer reaches its ledger.head anchor: the anchored seq is ahead, or equal with a different hash.
warden.audit:_head_behind.detail: An anchor with a non-integer seq counts as behind so it is never silently overwritten; no anchor returns False.

warden.audit:_read_break.what: Reads the sticky state_dir/ledger.broken record of an earlier truncation or rewrite; returns None if the file does not exist.
warden.audit:_read_break.detail: An unreadable or non-dict file returns a placeholder reason, so the break is still reported.

warden.audit:audit.what: Appends one event and its fields as a hash-chained line (ts, event, seq, prev_hash, hash) to audit.jsonl, then updates ledger.head.
warden.audit:audit.detail: Thread-safe via a lock. If the head anchor is ahead of the file, writes ledger.broken and a ledger_tamper_detected entry first so the break stays visible.

warden.audit:_read_ledger.what: Returns the ledger file's lines, or an empty list if the file cannot be read.

warden.audit:_read_head.what: Reads the ledger.head anchor as a dict with seq and hash; returns None if the file is missing.
warden.audit:_read_head.detail: Unreadable or malformed content returns {seq: None, hash: None}, so verification treats it as broken rather than absent.

warden.audit:verify_ledger.what: Walks every ledger line checking seq order, prev_hash and the recomputed hash, plus the head anchor and break file; returns ok, entries, broken_at_seq, reason.
warden.audit:verify_ledger.detail: Detects unreadable lines, legacy lines after chaining starts, gaps, reordering, edits, a rewritten or truncated tail, and breaks recorded earlier in ledger.broken.

warden.audit:verify_ledger.<locals>.brok.what: Builds the failure result: ok False, the entries counted so far, the currently expected seq as broken_at_seq, and the given reason.

warden.audit:_mentions.what: Returns True if a ledger entry refers to a resource id through resource_id, resource_ids, approved_ids, blocked, or any results row.

warden.audit:history.what: Returns up to limit ledger entries that mention a resource id, newest first, trimming scan results to the rows about that resource.
warden.audit:history.detail: Reads only the local ledger, no AWS calls; a blank id returns an empty list and a bad limit falls back to 50.

warden.audit:_ledger_entries.what: Parses every ledger line into a list of dict entries, skipping lines that are not valid JSON objects.

warden.audit:_void_recorded.what: Finds the quarantine_void ledger entry for an Elastic IP allocation id and quarantined-at timestamp; returns it or None.

warden.audit:record_quarantine_void.what: Logs a quarantine_void audit event when a quarantined Elastic IP is seen in use, at most once per quarantine (keyed by its warden:quarantined-at tag).
warden.audit:record_quarantine_void.detail: A voided quarantine can no longer justify releasing the address.

warden.audit:_parse_iso.what: Parses an ISO-8601 string (Z suffix allowed) into a UTC-aware datetime; returns None for empty or invalid input.

warden.audit:quarantine_problem.what: Returns why an Elastic IP's quarantine cannot justify release, or None when it can: it needs a matching Warden receipt, no void, unchanged tags and an ended window.
warden.audit:quarantine_problem.detail: Scans quarantine_address receipts for a done result with the same quarantined-at; trusts the receipt's window, not the mutable tags. require_over=False skips the window-ended check.

warden.audit:_receipts_dir.what: Returns the receipts folder path, state_dir/receipts.

warden.audit:save_receipt.what: Writes a receipt dict atomically to state_dir/receipts/<receipt_id>.json and returns the path.
warden.audit:save_receipt.detail: Raises ValueError unless receipt_id matches rcpt-[A-Za-z0-9-]+, which also blocks path traversal.

warden.audit:load_receipt.what: Loads a receipt by id from the receipts folder; returns None when the id is malformed, the file is missing, or the JSON is invalid.

warden.audit:list_receipts.what: Returns up to limit receipt summaries (receipt_id, action, plan_id, finished_at, counts), newest first by finished_at.
warden.audit:list_receipts.detail: Skips unreadable files; returns an empty list when the receipts folder does not exist.

warden.aws:AwsClients.what: Holds one boto3 session for the configured region and lazily creates and caches service clients, switching to the moto endpoint in mock mode.

warden.aws:AwsClients.__init__.what: Stores settings and builds a boto3 Session for the region, using dummy MOCK_CREDENTIALS in mock mode unless a session is passed in.
warden.aws:AwsClients.__init__.detail: In mock mode real AWS keys are never loaded.

warden.aws:AwsClients.client.what: Creates a new boto3 client for any service, against real AWS or, in mock mode, against mock_endpoint with mock hooks installed.
warden.aws:AwsClients.client.detail: Default config uses adaptive retries with up to 8 attempts; mock mode passes the client through warden.mock.install_hooks.

warden.aws:AwsClients._client.what: Forwards to client(service, config); the cached client properties call it.

warden.aws:AwsClients.ec2.what: Returns a cached EC2 client for the region with the default adaptive-retry config.

warden.aws:AwsClients.cloudwatch.what: Returns a cached CloudWatch client for the region with the default adaptive-retry config.

warden.aws:AwsClients.cloudtrail.what: Returns a cached CloudTrail client that uses the fail-fast evidence config.
warden.aws:AwsClients.cloudtrail.detail: Evidence config: 2 total attempts, 3 s connect and 8 s read timeouts, so a slow optional API cannot push a call past the 240 s MCP timeout.

warden.aws:AwsClients.rbin.what: Returns a cached Recycle Bin (rbin) client that uses the fail-fast evidence config.

warden.aws:AwsClients.route53.what: Returns a cached Route 53 client that uses the fail-fast evidence config.

warden.aws:AwsClients.elbv2.what: Returns a cached Elastic Load Balancing v2 client that uses the fail-fast evidence config.

warden.aws:AwsClients.sts.what: Returns a cached STS client with the default retry config.

warden.aws:AwsClients.account_id.what: Returns the caller's AWS account id and caches it after the first call.
warden.aws:AwsClients.account_id.detail: Calls sts.get_caller_identity once per AwsClients instance.

warden.aws:error_code.what: Returns the AWS error code from a botocore ClientError ('Unknown' if absent), or the exception class name for any other error.

warden.aws:wait_for.what: Runs a named boto3 waiter with the given delay and attempts, retrying when it fails with a *.NotFound code caused by EC2 eventual consistency.
warden.aws:wait_for.detail: Each retry uses one fewer attempt and sleeps delay seconds first; other WaiterErrors, or running out of attempts, re-raise.

warden.aws:dry_run.what: Calls an AWS operation with DryRun=True and returns 'would_succeed', 'denied: <code>' or 'error: <code>' to say whether AWS would allow it.
warden.aws:dry_run.detail: A normal return with no error yields 'error: DryRunNotHonoured', because AWS always answers a DryRun with an error.

warden.config:Settings.what: Frozen dataclass holding all Warden runtime settings: region, scope tag, freeze flag, batch and idle thresholds, TTLs, time budgets, state_dir, host, port and mock_endpoint.

warden.config:Settings.mock.what: Property that is True when mock_endpoint is set, meaning Warden talks to a local moto server instead of real AWS.

warden.config:Settings.scope_label.what: Property that returns the scope as readable text: 'key=value' for the scope tag, or 'all resources' when none is set.

warden.config:is_frozen.what: Returns True when WARDEN_FREEZE was set at start-up or a FREEZE file exists in state_dir; the file is checked on every call.
warden.config:is_frozen.detail: Creating state_dir/FREEZE halts Warden without a restart.
