warden.config:_get.what: Reads an environment value, strips whitespace and returns None when it is missing or blank.

warden.config:_int.what: Parses an integer environment value, returning the default when unset and enforcing an optional minimum.
warden.config:_int.detail: Raises ValueError naming the variable if the value is not an integer or is below the minimum.

warden.config:_float.what: Parses a non-negative float environment value, returning the default when unset.
warden.config:_float.detail: Raises ValueError for non-numeric, negative or NaN values.

warden.config:_bool.what: Parses a boolean environment value from words like true, yes, on, 1 or false, no, off, 0, empty; returns the default when unset.
warden.config:_bool.detail: Raises ValueError for any other text.

warden.config:_profile_region.what: Returns the region configured for AWS_PROFILE in the standard AWS config chain (~/.aws/config), or None if it cannot be read.
warden.config:_profile_region.detail: Creates a boto3.Session only to read region_name; any exception returns None.

warden.config:_scope.what: Parses WARDEN_SCOPE_TAG in key=value form into a (key, value) pair, or (None, None) when unset.
warden.config:_scope.detail: Raises ValueError when the '=' or either side is missing.

warden.config:_mock_endpoint.what: Reads WARDEN_MOCK_ENDPOINT, requires it to start with http:// or https://, and returns it without a trailing slash; None when unset.
warden.config:_mock_endpoint.detail: Raises ValueError for a value that is not a URL.

warden.config:load_settings.what: Builds Settings from a given mapping, or from .env plus os.environ, applying defaults, minimums and validation to every WARDEN_* and AWS region variable.
warden.config:load_settings.detail: Region order: AWS_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, profile region, then us-east-1. WARDEN_MAX_BATCH is clamped to 1-20.

warden.mock:_Http.what: Minimal fake botocore HTTP response carrying only the fields botocore reads: status_code, headers, raw, content and text.

warden.mock:_Http.__init__.what: Sets the status code and empty headers, raw, content and text fields on the fake response.

warden.mock:_ok.what: Returns a fake 200 response and the body with ResponseMetadata and a random RequestId added.

warden.mock:_error.what: Returns a fake error response and a body with Error Code and Message plus ResponseMetadata; HTTP status defaults to 400.

warden.mock:_now.what: Returns the current UTC time as a timezone-aware datetime.

warden.mock:_parse.what: Parses an ISO-8601 string into a datetime with datetime.fromisoformat.

warden.mock:state_path.what: Returns the simulated Recycle Bin state file path, state_dir/mock/recycle_bin.json, shared by the MCP server and demo scripts.

warden.mock:reset_state.what: Deletes the simulated Recycle Bin state file if present, so a fresh moto server starts with no rules or binned snapshots.

warden.mock:_load.what: Loads the simulated Recycle Bin state as a dict with 'rules' and 'bin' keys, starting empty if the file is missing or invalid.

warden.mock:_save.what: Writes the simulated Recycle Bin state as JSON through a temp file and rename, creating the folder if needed.

warden.mock:_capture_params.what: botocore before-parameter-build hook that copies the caller's API arguments into the request context for later mock handlers.
warden.mock:_capture_params.detail: Needed because before-call handlers only see the serialised request.

warden.mock:_params.what: Returns the API arguments saved in a request context by _capture_params, or an empty dict.

warden.mock:_retention.what: Converts a Recycle Bin rule's RetentionPeriod into a timedelta of RetentionPeriodValue days.

warden.mock:_rbin_handler.what: Returns a before-call handler bound to these settings that simulates the rbin API from the shared mock state file.

warden.mock:_rbin_handler.<locals>.handl.what: Answers rbin CreateRule, ListRules, ListTagsForResource, GetRule and DeleteRule from the mock state file instead of moto.
warden.mock:_rbin_handler.<locals>.handl.detail: Returns ResourceNotFoundException for unknown rules and NotImplemented for other rbin operations; state is read and saved under a lock.

warden.mock:_keeps.what: Returns True if an available EBS_SNAPSHOT Recycle Bin rule would retain a snapshot with exactly these tags, using its include or exclude tag lists.
warden.mock:_keeps.detail: Uses scanner._tag_matches; a rule with include tags needs a match, otherwise any exclude-tag match disqualifies the snapshot.

warden.mock:_covering_rule.what: Returns the first Recycle Bin rule that would keep a snapshot with these tags, or None.

warden.mock:_purge_expired.what: Really deletes in moto every binned snapshot whose RecycleBinExitTime has passed and removes it from the bin; returns True if anything changed.
warden.mock:_purge_expired.detail: Sets a thread-local purging flag so the delete_snapshot hook lets the real delete through; delete errors are ignored.

warden.mock:_install_ec2_hooks.what: Registers botocore hooks on an EC2 client that simulate the snapshot Recycle Bin and age instance launch times.
warden.mock:_install_ec2_hooks.detail: Hooks DeleteSnapshot, DescribeSnapshots, ListSnapshotsInRecycleBin, RestoreSnapshotFromRecycleBin and DescribeInstances.

warden.mock:_install_ec2_hooks.<locals>..what: Before DeleteSnapshot, moves a snapshot covered by a Recycle Bin rule into the simulated bin with enter and exit times instead of deleting it.
warden.mock:_install_ec2_hooks.<locals>..detail: Skips DryRun and purge calls; already-binned ids return InvalidSnapshot.NotFound; uncovered or unknown snapshots fall through to moto's real delete.

warden.mock:_install_ec2_hooks.<locals>..what: After DescribeSnapshots, removes snapshots that sit in the simulated Recycle Bin from the parsed response.
Answers ListSnapshotsInRecycleBin from the mock state, optionally filtered by SnapshotIds, after purging expired entries.
warden.mock:_install_ec2_hooks.<locals>..detail: Returns enter and exit times as datetimes and leaves VolumeSize out of the rows.

warden.mock:_install_ec2_hooks.<locals>..what: Answers RestoreSnapshotFromRecycleBin by removing the snapshot from the simulated bin and returning it, same id, in completed state.
warden.mock:_install_ec2_hooks.<locals>..detail: DryRun returns DryRunOperation; an id not in the bin returns InvalidSnapshot.NotFound.

warden.mock:_install_ec2_hooks.<locals>..what: After DescribeInstances, moves every LaunchTime back by MOCK_INSTANCE_AGE (2 hours) so fresh moto instances pass Warden's boot warm-up check.

warden.mock:_install_cloudtrail_hooks.what: Registers a hook that answers CloudTrail LookupEvents with an empty event list, because moto does not implement it.

warden.mock:install_hooks.what: Attaches mock-mode shims to a boto3 client, parameter capture for every service plus rbin, EC2 or CloudTrail handlers, and returns the client.

warden.mock:seed_idle_metrics.what: Writes flat low CPUUtilization, NetworkIn and NetworkOut datapoints every 5 minutes for an instance, from hours_back ago to hours_ahead ahead; returns the timestamp count.
warden.mock:seed_idle_metrics.detail: Calls cloudwatch.put_metric_data in the AWS/EC2 namespace in batches, so scans find an idle history in mock mode.

warden.plan:ActionSpec.what: Frozen dataclass describing an action: its name, the resource type it applies to, and whether it is reversible.
warden.plan:ActionSpec.detail: ACTIONS registers six: quarantine_volume, recycle_snapshot, delete_snapshot, stop_instance, quarantine_address, release_address; delete_snapshot and release_address are irreversible.

warden.plan:PlanItem.what: Dataclass for one certified resource in a plan: resource_id, resource_type, verdict (act, keep or review), proposed action and state fingerprint.

warden.plan:Plan.what: Dataclass for a saved scan plan: plan id, creation and expiry times, account id, region, and PlanItems keyed by resource id.

warden.plan:Plan.to_dict.what: Converts the plan and its items into plain dicts for JSON storage.

warden.plan:Plan.from_dict.what: Rebuilds a Plan and its PlanItems from a stored dict, converting times to float and account and region to strings.
warden.plan:Plan.from_dict.detail: Raises KeyError or TypeError on missing or malformed fields; load_plan catches these.

warden.plan:_sorted_tags.what: Returns a resource's tags as a sorted list of [key, value] pairs so fingerprints are stable.

warden.plan:fingerprint.what: Returns sha256 of a resource's state-relevant fields plus its sorted tags, with fields chosen per type: volume, snapshot, instance or address.
warden.plan:fingerprint.detail: Lets later steps detect that a resource changed since the scan; an unknown resource type raises ValueError.

warden.plan:new_plan.what: Creates a Plan with a new plan id and the given account, region and items, expiring after settings.plan_ttl_minutes.

warden.plan:_plan_path.what: Returns the plan file path, state_dir/plans/<plan_id>.json.

warden.plan:save_plan.what: Writes a plan atomically to state_dir/plans/<plan_id>.json and returns the path.
warden.plan:save_plan.detail: Raises ValueError unless plan_id matches plan-[A-Za-z0-9-]+, which also blocks path traversal.

warden.plan:load_plan.what: Loads a plan by id, returning None when the id is unsafe or the file is missing or malformed.

warden.plan:_fail.what: Returns a whole-request rejection: the plan if known, no approved ids, and {'*': reason}.

warden.plan:validate_request.what: Checks a mutating request against its saved plan and returns (plan, approved_ids, rejected), with a rejection reason per id.
warden.plan:validate_request.detail: Rejects unknown actions, missing or expired plans, account or region mismatch, wildcards, multiple ids for irreversible actions, batches over max_batch, and ids not planned for this action.

warden.policy:tags_to_dict.what: Converts an AWS tag list of {Key, Value} dicts into a plain key-to-value dict, skipping entries without a Key.

warden.policy:_clean.what: Removes control characters from text and truncates it to 256 characters.

warden.policy:sanitize_tags.what: Returns a copy of a tag dict with control characters stripped and keys and values truncated to 256 characters.

warden.policy:_lower.what: Returns a tag dict with keys and values stripped and lower-cased for case-insensitive checks.

warden.policy:protection_reasons.what: Returns reasons a resource is protected by its tags: env, environment or stage starting with prod or prd, a legal-hold key, DR tags, or warden:protect=true.
warden.policy:protection_reasons.detail: The prod/prd prefix rule matches the IAM deny in iam/warden-policy.json; preprod, staging and nonprod stay unprotected.

warden.policy:managed_by_reasons.what: Returns reasons a resource is owned by IaC, autoscaling, Kubernetes, AWS Backup or DLM, based on known tag keys, key prefixes, or managed-by tool values.
warden.policy:managed_by_reasons.detail: Such resources would come back or break deploys if changed by hand.

warden.policy:_fold.what: Normalises text with NFKD, drops invisible, accent and control characters, lower-cases it, and maps Cyrillic and Greek look-alikes to Latin letters.

warden.policy:_normalise.what: Folds text with _fold, then collapses all punctuation, underscores and separators into single spaces.

warden.policy:injection_reasons.what: Returns one fixed reason if any tag key or value, after folding, matches instruction-like patterns such as 'ignore previous instructions' or 'without approval'.
warden.policy:injection_reasons.detail: Returns an empty list otherwise. Matching tags are treated as data and send the resource to human review.

warden.policy:keep_reasons.what: Returns all reasons to keep a resource: protection reasons, then managed-by reasons, then injection reasons.

warden.policy:in_scope.what: Returns True when no scope tag is configured, or when the resource's tags carry the scope key with the scope value, compared case-insensitively.

warden.policy:copyable_tags.what: Returns the tags Warden may rewrite onto another resource, dropping keys with the reserved aws: prefix.

warden.pricing:_rates.what: Returns the EBS, snapshot and Elastic IP rate table for a region, falling back to us-east-1 rates.

warden.pricing:volume_monthly_usd.what: Estimates an EBS volume's monthly list price from its type, size, IOPS, throughput and region, rounded to cents.
warden.pricing:volume_monthly_usd.detail: gp3 charges IOPS above 3000 and throughput above 125; io1 and io2 charge all provisioned IOPS; unknown types use gp2 rates.

warden.pricing:snapshot_monthly_usd.what: Estimates a snapshot's monthly cost as source size in GiB times the regional snapshot rate, rounded to cents.
warden.pricing:snapshot_monthly_usd.detail: An upper bound: AWS bills snapshots on stored changed blocks, not the full volume size.

warden.pricing:address_monthly_usd.what: Returns the monthly list price of one idle Elastic IP or public IPv4 address: the hourly rate times 730 hours.

warden.pricing:instance_monthly_usd.what: Returns an instance type's monthly on-demand Linux price (hourly rate times 730), or None if the type is not in the table.
warden.pricing:instance_monthly_usd.detail: Falls back to the us-east-1 price when the region or the type is missing from the regional table.

agent.setup_agent:SetupError.what: Exception type carrying a clear, user-facing configuration error message, such as a missing model or unreadable instructions file.
agent.setup_agent:SetupError.detail: Raised by require_model and load_instructions; main catches it, prints 'error: ...' to stderr and returns exit code 2.

agent.setup_agent:build_mcp_server_manif.what: Takes the Warden MCP URL and returns a remote MCP server manifest named 'warden' with a description and that URL.
agent.setup_agent:build_mcp_server_manif.detail: No auth block: the server is assumed to run on a trusted network.

agent.setup_agent:_mcp_entry.what: Returns an agent's MCP-server entry for 'warden' listing the enabled tools, the tools that require approval, and preload=True.
agent.setup_agent:_mcp_entry.detail: Sets the TrueForge fields enable_tools and require_approval_for_tools.

agent.setup_agent:build_warden_manifest.what: Takes a model name and system prompt and returns the interactive Warden agent spec with all tools enabled and every GATED_TOOLS mutation requiring approval.
agent.setup_agent:build_warden_manifest.detail: Temperature 0.1; sandbox with file downloads, generative UI and ask_user_questions on; dynamic sub-agents off; iteration_limit 60.

agent.setup_agent:build_reporter_manifes.what: Returns the unattended warden-reporter agent spec that enables only REPORTER_TOOLS (read-only) and still requires approval for anything '@destructive'.
agent.setup_agent:build_reporter_manifes.detail: Uses REPORTER_INSTRUCTIONS by default; temperature 0.1; ask_user_questions off; dynamic sub-agents off; iteration_limit 30. Excludes watchdog_verify.

agent.setup_agent:require_model.what: Reads TRUEFORGE_MODEL from the environment mapping and returns it stripped, or raises SetupError explaining how to set it.
agent.setup_agent:require_model.detail: Raises SetupError when the variable is missing or blank.

agent.setup_agent:load_instructions.what: Reads the Warden system prompt from agent/instructions.md (or a given path) and returns the stripped text.
agent.setup_agent:load_instructions.detail: Raises SetupError if the file cannot be read (OSError) or is empty.

agent.setup_agent:build_payloads.what: Builds everything setup would send: the MCP server manifest (WARDEN_MCP_URL or default) and the warden agent, plus warden-reporter when reporter is True.
agent.setup_agent:build_payloads.detail: Default MCP URL is http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp; raises SetupError via require_model or load_instructions.

agent.setup_agent:find_agent_id.what: Lists TrueForge agents filtered by name and returns the id of the agent whose name matches exactly, or None.

agent.setup_agent:upsert_agent.what: Creates the named agent if it does not exist, otherwise updates its manifest and description; returns ('created' or 'updated', agent_id).
agent.setup_agent:upsert_agent.detail: Uses client.agents.create/update; on ConflictError from a create race it looks the id up again and updates, re-raising if still not found.

agent.setup_agent:apply.what: Creates a TrueForge client, saves the MCP server manifest with create_or_update, then upserts each agent and prints the outcome.
agent.setup_agent:apply.detail: Calls client.settings.mcp_servers.create_or_update and upsert_agent; token is optional (only for OIDC-enabled TrueForge).

agent.setup_agent:outbound_guard_hint.what: Takes the MCP URL and returns instructions for letting TrueForge's outbound URL guard reach that private host.
agent.setup_agent:outbound_guard_hint.detail: Suggests restarting TrueForge with OUTBOUND_URL_ALLOWED_HOSTS set to the host, or NETWORK_POLICY_ENABLED=false for a local-only demo.

agent.setup_agent:main.what: CLI entry: parses --reporter and --dry-run, loads .env, builds payloads, then prints them (dry run) or applies them to TrueForge; returns an exit code.
agent.setup_agent:main.detail: Returns 2 on SetupError, 1 on any SDK/network failure (with outbound-guard hint when blocked), else 0. Base URL defaults to http://localhost:8790.

scripts._common:extra_client.what: Returns a boto3 client for a service AwsClients does not expose directly, such as ssm or iam.

scripts._common:is_demo.what: Returns True only if a tag list has the exact key warden:demo with value 'true' (case-insensitive, whitespace stripped).

scripts._common:demo_tags.what: Builds an AWS tag list containing warden:demo=true, an optional Name tag, and any extra key/value pairs.

scripts._common:_offered_azs.what: Pages through instance type offerings and returns the set of AZ names that offer the given instance type, or None if the lookup fails.
scripts._common:_offered_azs.detail: Calls ec2.describe_instance_type_offerings with LocationType availability-zone; any exception means 'unknown, do not filter'.

scripts._common:default_subnet.what: Returns the default VPC's available default-for-AZ subnet in the alphabetically first AZ offering the instance type, or None if none exists.
scripts._common:default_subnet.detail: Calls ec2.describe_vpcs (isDefault) and describe_subnets; falls back to any available subnet if none is default-for-AZ.

scripts._common:resolve_al2023_ami.what: Returns (ami_id, source) for the latest Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMI, trying the SSM public parameter first and then describe_images.
scripts._common:resolve_al2023_ami.detail: Sources are 'ssm', 'describe_images' (newest CreationDate owned by amazon), or (None, 'none') when both fail.

scripts._common:rule_covers_recycle_tag.what: Returns True if a Recycle Bin rule would retain snapshots tagged warden:recycle=true, using the same check as the scanner.
scripts._common:rule_covers_recycle_tag.detail: Delegates to warden.scanner.rule_covers (rule must be available with at least 7 days retention).

scripts._common:list_snapshot_rules.what: Pages all EBS_SNAPSHOT Recycle Bin rules and returns each summary merged with its get_rule details.
scripts._common:list_snapshot_rules.detail: Calls rbin.list_rules and rbin.get_rule; rules whose details fail are skipped; raises on list access errors.

scripts._common:find_warden_rule.what: Returns the first EBS snapshot Recycle Bin rule that keeps warden:recycle=true snapshots, or None.

scripts._common:run_main.what: Runs a script's main() and converts AWS or configuration failures into a one-line stderr message with exit code 2.
scripts._common:run_main.detail: Handles NoCredentialsError, NoRegionError, ClientError, BotoCoreError, ValueError and KeyboardInterrupt.

scripts.mock_server:main.what: Parses --host/--port, clears the simulated Recycle Bin state, starts an in-memory moto server, prints the endpoint, and blocks until Ctrl+C.
scripts.mock_server:main.detail: Uses moto.server.ThreadedMotoServer and warden.mock.reset_state; defaults to 127.0.0.1:5000 and hints to set WARDEN_MOCK_ENDPOINT if it differs.

scripts.plant:Planter.what: Creates the warden:demo=true demo resources in one AZ, idempotently, and tracks each item's monthly cost and whether Warden should clean it.
scripts.plant:Planter.detail: Uses AWS waiters between steps and has mock-mode workarounds for moto.

scripts.plant:Planter.__init__.what: Stores AWS clients, settings, output function and waiter delay, and initialises the cost list, subnet, AZ and AMI fields.

scripts.plant:Planter._wait.what: Waits on a named EC2 waiter with the configured delay and up to 120 attempts.
scripts.plant:Planter._wait.detail: Uses warden.aws.wait_for, which retries *.NotFound errors right after a create.

scripts.plant:Planter._find_volume.what: Returns the first EBS volume with the given Name tag in a creating, available or in-use state, or None.
scripts.plant:Planter._find_volume.detail: Calls ec2.describe_volumes with tag and status filters.

scripts.plant:Planter._find_snapshot.what: Returns the first self-owned snapshot with the given Name tag in pending or completed state, or None.

scripts.plant:Planter._find_instance.what: Returns the first instance with the given Name tag in pending, running, stopping or stopped state, or None.
scripts.plant:Planter._find_instance.detail: Calls ec2.describe_instances with tag and instance-state-name filters.

scripts.plant:Planter._find_template.what: Returns the launch template with the given name, or None when AWS reports it does not exist.
scripts.plant:Planter._find_template.detail: Calls ec2.describe_launch_templates; re-raises errors other than NotFound or InvalidLaunchTemplateName.

scripts.plant:Planter._find_image.what: Returns the first self-owned AMI with the given name in pending or available state, or None.

scripts.plant:Planter._create_volume.what: Creates a demo-tagged EBS volume of the given size and type in the planter's AZ and waits until it is available.
scripts.plant:Planter._create_volume.detail: Calls ec2.create_volume with TagSpecifications from demo_tags, then the volume_available waiter.

scripts.plant:Planter._snapshot_of_temp_.what: Creates an 8 GiB gp3 helper volume, snapshots it with demo tags, waits for completion, deletes the helper, and returns the snapshot id.
scripts.plant:Planter._snapshot_of_temp_.detail: Calls create_volume, create_snapshot, snapshot_completed waiter and delete_volume; the resulting snapshot's source volume no longer exists.

scripts.plant:Planter._log.what: Writes a formatted '[status] item: detail' line through the output function.

scripts.plant:Planter._cost.what: Appends a (label, monthly USD, cleanable) entry to the cost list, treating a missing price as 0.

scripts.plant:Planter.plain_volume.what: Creates an unattached demo volume with the given name, size, type and extra tags unless it already exists, then records its list-price cost.
scripts.plant:Planter.plain_volume.detail: Used for the unused 500 GiB gp2 volume, the env=production disk and the ManagedBy=terraform disk; cost via pricing.volume_monthly_usd.

scripts.plant:Planter.leak.what: Creates a launch template whose 200 GiB /dev/sdf disk has DeleteOnTermination=false, launches and terminates an instance from it, leaving an orphaned volume.
scripts.plant:Planter.leak.detail: Calls create_launch_template, run_instances, terminate_instances; reuses a leftover worker instance; in mock mode creates the orphan volume directly because moto ignores template disks.

scripts.plant:Planter._ensure_tagged.what: Adds the warden:demo=true tag to a resource id, because some APIs ignore TagSpecifications.

scripts.plant:Planter.orphan_snapshot.what: Creates warden-demo-orphan-snapshot from a temporary volume that is then deleted, unless it already exists, and records its cost as cleanable.

scripts.plant:Planter.unused_ip.what: Allocates an unassociated VPC Elastic IP named warden-demo-unused-ip unless one exists, and records its monthly cost as cleanable.
scripts.plant:Planter.unused_ip.detail: Calls ec2.describe_addresses, allocate_address and create_tags; cost via pricing.address_monthly_usd.

scripts.plant:Planter.idle_server.what: Launches a t3.micro warden-demo-idle-server whose user data starts a frozen fake 'aws s3 cp' process, and records its cost as cleanable.
scripts.plant:Planter.idle_server.detail: Calls run_instances and the instance_running waiter; in mock mode seeds synthetic idle CloudWatch datapoints via warden.mock.seed_idle_metrics.

scripts.plant:Planter.ami_chain.what: Creates a golden snapshot, registers warden-demo-golden-ami from it, and creates launch template warden-demo-web-lt using that AMI, recording cost as not cleanable.
scripts.plant:Planter.ami_chain.detail: Calls register_image, create_tags and create_launch_template; in mock mode adopts moto's own AMI snapshot.

scripts.plant:Planter._mock_adopt_ami_sn.what: In moto, tags the snapshot actually backing the AMI as the golden snapshot and deletes the unused helper snapshot.
scripts.plant:Planter._mock_adopt_ami_sn.detail: Calls describe_images, create_tags and delete_snapshot; does nothing if the AMI already uses the given snapshot.

scripts.plant:Planter.injection_volume.what: Creates a 50 GiB gp3 volume whose Name and note tags contain instruction-like prompt-injection text, recording its cost as not cleanable.
scripts.plant:Planter.injection_volume.detail: Tests that Warden treats tag text as untrusted data and flags it as suspicious.

scripts.plant:Planter.recycle_rule.what: Creates a 7-day EBS_SNAPSHOT Recycle Bin rule for warden:recycle=true snapshots, tagged warden:demo=true, unless a covering rule already exists.
scripts.plant:Planter.recycle_rule.detail: Calls rbin.create_rule; on any error logs BLOCKED and notes snapshots fall back to delete_snapshot_permanently, one id per approval.

scripts.plant:Planter.run.what: Resolves the default subnet and AL2023 AMI, plants the nine demo items plus the Recycle Bin rule, and returns the estimated cleanable monthly waste.
scripts.plant:Planter.run.detail: Raises SystemExit if no suitable subnet or AMI; a failing item is logged as FAILED and the rest continue.

scripts.plant:Planter.summary.what: Prints the estimated monthly waste Warden should clean, the total cost of all planted items, and timing and cleanup reminders; returns the cleanable total.
scripts.plant:Planter.summary.detail: Real-AWS reminder: plant about 35 minutes before the scan for CloudWatch idle data and CloudTrail events.

scripts.plant:main.what: Loads settings, builds AwsClients, and runs the Planter; returns 0.
scripts.plant:main.detail: Invoked through run_main when run as a script.

scripts.preflight:_row.what: Returns a check result dict with check name, status, detail and what a failure disables.

scripts.preflight:_safe.what: Runs one check function and returns its row, turning any exception into a BLOCKED row with the error code and truncated message.

scripts.preflight:_dry_run_row.what: Turns a dry_run result string into an OK row when it is 'would_succeed', otherwise a BLOCKED row naming what it disables.

scripts.preflight:run_checks.what: Runs every read-only account and region check in order and returns the list of result rows.
scripts.preflight:run_checks.detail: Includes DryRun probes of ec2.create_volume and run_instances t3.micro via warden.aws.dry_run; run_instances is BLOCKED/skipped when no AMI resolved.

scripts.preflight:render.what: Formats the check rows as a plain-text table and lists what each non-OK item disables, or 'All checks OK.'

scripts.preflight:main.what: Loads settings, prints a header with region and scope, runs the checks and prints the rendered table; always returns 0.
scripts.preflight:main.detail: Invoked through run_main when run as a script.

scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.id.what: Calls STS get_caller_identity and returns an OK row with the account and ARN.

scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.re.what: Lists availability zones and returns an OK row with the region and its available AZ names.

scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.vp.what: Finds the default subnet in an AZ offering t3.micro, saves it for later probes, and returns OK, or BLOCKED if none exists.
scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.vp.detail: Uses default_subnet; BLOCKED disables plant.py instances and the launch-template leak demo.

scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.am.what: Resolves the AL2023 AMI, saves it for the run_instances probe, and returns OK via SSM, WARN via describe_images, or BLOCKED.

scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.rb.what: Looks for the Warden Recycle Bin rule and returns OK if present, or WARN noting plant.py creates it.
scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.rb.detail: Uses find_warden_rule; without the rule reversible snapshot recycling is unavailable.

scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.cl.what: Reads one CloudTrail event to confirm lookup access and returns an OK row.
Requests the last hour of EC2 CPUUtilization statistics to confirm metric access and returns an OK row.
scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.cl.detail: cloudwatch.get_metric_statistics; failure disables idle-instance detection (instances become 'review').

scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.ss.what: Reads the AL2023 SSM public parameter to confirm access and returns an OK row.
scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.ss.detail: ssm.get_parameter; failure is not critical because the AMI lookup falls back to describe_images.

scripts.preflight:run_checks.<locals>.ia.what: Calls IAM get_account_summary to confirm IAM read access and returns an OK row.

scripts.reset:_name.what: Returns the Name tag value from an AWS tag list, or an empty string.

scripts.reset:find_demo_resources.what: Lists warden:demo=true instances, launch templates, AMIs, volumes, snapshots and Elastic IPs (optionally Recycle Bin rules), grouped by type and re-checked client-side.
scripts.reset:find_demo_resources.detail: Uses describe_* with tag filters and paginators; skips terminated instances, deleting/deleted volumes and addresses without AllocationId.

scripts.reset:_demo_rules.what: Returns snapshot Recycle Bin rules whose own tags include warden:demo=true.
scripts.reset:_demo_rules.detail: Calls rbin.list_tags_for_resource per rule; on error prints a message and returns what it has.

scripts.reset:Resetter.what: Deletes the resources returned by find_demo_resources in a dependency-safe order, logging each success or failure.

scripts.reset:Resetter.__init__.what: Stores the AWS clients, EC2 client, output function and waiter delay.

scripts.reset:Resetter._do.what: Runs one delete callable, prints 'deleted' or 'FAILED' with the error code, and returns whether it succeeded.

scripts.reset:Resetter._do_retry.what: Like _do, but retries with a sleep while AWS returns the given error code, then makes a final _do attempt.
scripts.reset:Resetter._do_retry.detail: Used with InvalidSnapshot.InUse for a snapshot whose AMI was just deregistered; default 5 attempts.

scripts.reset:Resetter.run.what: Terminates demo instances and waits, then deletes launch templates, deregisters AMIs, deletes detached volumes and snapshots, releases unassociated Elastic IPs, and deletes rules.
scripts.reset:Resetter.run.detail: Calls terminate_instances, delete_launch_template, deregister_image, delete_volume, delete_snapshot, release_address, rbin.delete_rule; skips in-use volumes and associated addresses.

scripts.reset:Resetter._refresh_volumes.what: Re-reads volume states after instance termination and returns the volumes with current state, dropping any no longer found.
scripts.reset:Resetter._refresh_volumes.detail: Calls ec2.describe_volumes; returns the input unchanged if the call fails.

scripts.reset:describe.what: Returns one human-readable line per found resource with its kind, id, name and state or public IP.

scripts.reset:reset.what: Finds demo resources and prints them as a dry run, or deletes them with Resetter when yes=True; returns what was found.
scripts.reset:reset.detail: Notes the Recycle Bin rule is kept unless include_recycle_rule, and that recycled snapshots expire after 7 days.

scripts.reset:main.what: Parses --yes and --include-recycle-rule, loads settings, and calls reset; returns 0.
scripts.reset:main.detail: Without --yes nothing is deleted. Invoked through run_main when run as a script.

mcp_tools.name: warden_status
mcp_tools.summary: Reports account, region, scope, freeze, limits, TTLs, Recycle Bin readiness, ledger integrity and approval rules.

mcp_tools.name: scan_for_waste
mcp_tools.summary: Scans idle volumes, snapshots, instances and Elastic IPs and returns findings, savings and a plan_id.

mcp_tools.name: get_plan
mcp_tools.summary: Returns a saved plan by plan_id with an expired flag.

mcp_tools.name: get_receipt
mcp_tools.summary: Returns the full receipt of a past Warden action.

mcp_tools.name: list_receipts
mcp_tools.summary: Lists recent action receipts newest first.

mcp_tools.name: list_warden_backups
mcp_tools.summary: Lists Warden backup snapshots with original volume, expiry and restore instructions.

mcp_tools.name: watchdog_verify
mcp_tools.summary: Runs the independent Watchdog re-check and returns a single-use signoff token for approved ids.

mcp_tools.name: rollback_window
mcp_tools.summary: Lists every still-undoable Warden change with countdowns and undo tools.

mcp_tools.name: resource_history
mcp_tools.summary: Returns ledger entries mentioning a resource id or Name tag, without AWS calls.

mcp_tools.name: quarantine_volumes
mcp_tools.summary: Backs up then deletes planned unattached EBS volumes; requires signoff and approval.

mcp_tools.name: recycle_snapshots
mcp_tools.summary: Moves planned orphan snapshots to the Recycle Bin; requires signoff and approval.

mcp_tools.name: delete_snapshot_permanently
mcp_tools.summary: Irreversibly deletes one planned snapshot when no Recycle Bin rule exists; requires signoff and approval.

mcp_tools.name: stop_instances
mcp_tools.summary: Stops planned idle EC2 instances; requires signoff and approval.

mcp_tools.name: release_address
mcp_tools.summary: Irreversibly releases one Elastic IP after its quarantine window; requires signoff and approval.

mcp_tools.name: quarantine_addresses
mcp_tools.summary: Tags planned unassociated Elastic IPs as quarantined for the window; requires signoff and approval.

mcp_tools.name: restore_volume
mcp_tools.summary: Recreates a quarantined volume from its Warden backup snapshot.

mcp_tools.name: restore_snapshot
mcp_tools.summary: Restores a Warden-recycled snapshot from the Recycle Bin.

mcp_tools.name: cancel_address_quarantine
mcp_tools.summary: Removes Warden's quarantine tags from one Elastic IP.

config.name: AWS_REGION
config.meaning: First choice for the AWS region Warden works in.

config.name: AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
config.meaning: Region used when AWS_REGION is not set.

config.name: AWS_PROFILE
config.meaning: Profile whose ~/.aws/config region is used when neither region variable is set; if that also fails the region is us-east-1.

config.name: WARDEN_SCOPE_TAG
config.meaning: Optional key=value tag; when set, only resources carrying that tag (case-insensitive) are in scope.

config.name: WARDEN_FREEZE
config.meaning: When true at start-up, is_frozen reports Warden as frozen.

config.name: WARDEN_MAX_BATCH
config.meaning: Maximum number of ids per reversible action call, clamped to 1-20.

config.name: WARDEN_IDLE_LOOKBACK_MINUTES
config.meaning: Minutes of CloudWatch history examined when judging idleness (minimum 5).

config.name: WARDEN_IDLE_CPU_PCT
config.meaning: An instance whose CPU utilisation reaches this percentage is not treated as idle.

config.name: WARDEN_IDLE_NETWORK_BYTES_PER_HOUR
config.meaning: An instance whose network traffic reaches this many bytes per hour is not treated as idle.

config.name: WARDEN_BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS
config.meaning: Days until backups Warden creates are tagged to expire (warden:expires-at); minimum 1.

config.name: WARDEN_PLAN_TTL_MINUTES
config.meaning: Minutes after which a scan plan expires and actions against it are refused (minimum 1).

config.name: WARDEN_OWNER_LOOKUP_LIMIT
config.meaning: Maximum number of resources per scan whose creator is looked up (minimum 0).

config.name: WARDEN_SNAPSHOT_WAIT_SECONDS
config.meaning: Longest time to wait for a backup snapshot to complete before quarantining a volume (minimum 5).

config.name: WARDEN_QUARANTINE_MINUTES
config.meaning: Length of an Elastic IP quarantine window before release can be allowed (minimum 1).

config.name: WARDEN_SIGNOFF_TTL_MINUTES
config.meaning: Minutes a single-use sign-off token stays valid (minimum 1).

config.name: WARDEN_SCAN_BUDGET_SECONDS
config.meaning: Scan time budget; owner lookups are skipped once half of it is used (minimum 10).

config.name: WARDEN_STATE_DIR
config.meaning: Folder for the ledger, receipts, plans, FREEZE file and mock state.

config.name: WARDEN_HOST
config.meaning: Host address the MCP server binds to.

config.name: WARDEN_PORT
config.meaning: Port the MCP server listens on (minimum 1).

config.name: WARDEN_MOCK_ENDPOINT
config.meaning: URL of a local moto server; when set, Warden runs in mock mode with dummy credentials and never reaches real AWS.

config.name: <state_dir>/FREEZE (file)
config.meaning: If this file exists Warden is frozen; it is checked on every call, so no restart is needed.

config.name: <repo>/.env (file)
config.meaning: Loaded with python-dotenv by load_settings before reading os.environ when no env mapping is passed.

config.name: _BOTO_CONFIG (aws.py)
config.meaning: botocore retry config for the EC2, CloudWatch and STS clients and any client made without an explicit config.

config.name: _EVIDENCE_CONFIG (aws.py)
config.default: standard retries, total_max_attempts 2, connect 3 s, read 8 s
config.meaning: Fail-fast botocore config for the optional CloudTrail, Recycle Bin, Route 53 and ELBv2 clients.

config.name: MOCK_CREDENTIALS (mock.py)

iam.summary: warden-policy.json allows read-only discovery (EC2 Describe*, CloudWatch metrics, CloudTrail LookupEvents, Recycle Bin rule reads, Route 53 and ELB reads, STS), creating snapshots and volumes for backup and restore, tagging with any keys only on create and otherwise only warden:* keys, DeleteVolume, DeleteSnapshot, RestoreSnapshotFromRecycleBin, Stop/StartInstances, ReleaseAddress, and KMS key use only through EBS. Explicit Deny statements, which override any Allow, block instance termination, writing the warden:protect tag, and destructive actions on production, legal-hold, disaster-recovery or warden:protect=true resources. There is no S3, IAM, TerminateInstances or KMS key-management permission.
denies: DenyProtectTagWrites: CreateTags/DeleteTags that include the warden:protect key
DenyDestructiveOnProdByEnvTag: DeleteVolume/DeleteSnapshot/StopInstances/ReleaseAddress when env tag starts with prod or prd
DenyDestructiveOnProdByEnvironmentTag: same four actions when environment tag starts with prod or prd
DenyDestructiveOnProdByStageTag: same four actions when stage tag starts with prod or prd
DenyDestructiveOnLegalHold: same four actions when a legal-hold tag is present
DenyDestructiveOnLegalHoldUnderscore: same four actions when a legal_hold tag is present
DenyDestructiveOnLegalHoldNoSeparator: same four actions when a legalhold tag is present
DenyDestructiveOnDrTag: same four actions when a dr tag is present and not false/no/0
DenyDestructiveOnDrRole: same four actions when role=dr
DenyDestructiveOnWardenProtect: same four actions when warden:protect=true

agent.summary: setup_agent.py registers a remote MCP server named 'warden' at WARDEN_MCP_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp) in TrueForge (default http://localhost:8790), then creates or updates the 'warden' agent using the required TRUEFORGE_MODEL at temperature 0.1 with agent/instructions.md as its prompt. That agent has all Warden tools enabled and every AWS-mutating tool requires human approval; sandbox, generative UI and ask-user questions are on, sub-agents off, 60 iterations. With --reporter it also adds 'warden-reporter', which enables only read tools, requires approval for '@destructive', and has a 30-iteration limit; --dry-run prints the payloads instead.
